items.title: 川普喊韓國投84億美元採油！韓方錯愕：協議裡沒有
items.title_en: Trump Calls for South Korea to Invest $8.4 Billion in Oil Recovery; South Korea Says No Such Clause in Agreement
paras: 美國總統川普周五(2日)宣稱，美韓貿易協議包含一項84億美元的提高原油採收率計畫，但韓方官員隨即表示，該項目並不在協議內。雙方說法落差，再度凸顯川普近期公布的韓國對美投資案，部分內容仍未獲韓方確認。
據《路透》報導，川普在Truth Social發文表示：「與大韓民國的協議愈來愈好！84億美元投入提高原油採收率計畫。生產更多石油與天然氣，意味美國能源主導地位，以及未來全球能源安全！」
不過，《韓聯社》引述韓國產業部官員表示，對這項說法感到意外，並指出協議範圍僅限首爾與華盛頓2025年11月公布的聯合事實清單，未包含該計畫。韓國駐美大使館未能立即聯繫上置評，白宮也未立即回應。
提高原油採收率技術(EOR)常透過向老舊油田注入二氧化碳，採出剩餘原油。大型石油公司支持這項技術，但許多環保團體反對，認為它可能延長對石油的依賴，不能視為氣候解方。
面對選民對美伊戰爭與高汽油價格的疑慮，川普正於11月期中選舉前密集宣傳經濟及投資協議，以強化政績。他周三才宣布，韓國將投資2,000億美元於美國項目，包括八座大型核電廠、天然氣管線及德州一座6GW發電設施。
這是韓國去年貿易協議中，總額3,500億美元戰略投資方案的首批重大項目；整體方案另包含1,500億美元造船投資。
然而，韓方隨即表示，其中540億美元的阿拉斯加液化天然氣(LNG)管線尚未定案，須符合商業與法律條件，並接受可行性及法定程序審查。
該管線也具有政治意義：阿拉斯加共和黨參議員Dan Sullivan正面臨民主黨Mary Peltola的競爭，爭取連任。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday (the 2nd) that the U.S.-South Korea trade deal includes an $8.4 billion plan to boost crude‑oil recovery, but South Korean officials immediately responded that the item is not in the agreement. The discrepancy underscores that parts of Trump’s recently announced South‑Korea‑to‑U.S. investment proposal have not been confirmed by Seoul.

In a post on Truth Social, Trump wrote: “The agreement with the Republic of Korea is getting better and better! $8.4 billion will be put into a plan to increase crude‑oil recovery. Producing more oil and natural gas means U.S. energy dominance and future global energy security!”

However, the Korean Press Agency (Yonhap) quoted a Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy official as saying the statement came as a surprise and noting that the agreement’s scope is limited to the joint fact‑sheet released by Seoul and Washington in November 2025, which does not include such a project. The South Korean embassy in Washington could not be reached for comment, and the White House did not respond immediately.

Enhanced oil recovery (EOR) technology typically involves injecting carbon dioxide into mature fields to extract remaining crude. Large oil majors back the technique, but many environmental groups oppose it, arguing it could prolong reliance on oil and should not be counted as a climate solution.

Facing voter concerns over the U.S.–Iraq war and high gasoline prices, Trump has been intensively promoting economic and investment deals ahead of the November mid‑term elections to bolster his record. He announced on Wednesday that South Korea will invest $200 billion in U.S. projects, including eight large nuclear power plants, natural‑gas pipelines and a 6 GW power facility in Texas.

This is the first batch of major projects under the $350 billion strategic investment package that was part of last year’s trade agreement, which also includes a $150 billion shipbuilding investment component.

South Korean officials, however, said that the $54 billion Alaska liquefied natural gas (LNG) pipeline has not yet been finalized, must meet commercial and legal conditions, and is subject to feasibility and statutory reviews.
The pipeline also carries political weight: Alaska Republican Senator Dan Sullivan is facing a re‑election challenge from Democrat Mary Peltola, making the project a potential campaign issue.

items.title: 輝達盤中再創高！市值衝5.7兆美元 史上首家6兆美元企業近了？
items.title_en: NVIDIA Hits New Intraday High! Market Cap Rises to $5.7 Trillion, Within $300 Billion of Becoming the First $6 Trillion Company?
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)股價周五盤中(2日)一度上漲2.9%，首度突破今年5月以來的紀錄，市值升至約5.7兆美元，距離成為史上首家市值達6兆美元的企業，已不到3,000億美元。投資人重新湧入這家全球市值最高的上市公司，帶動股價自7月底低點反彈近25%。
截稿前，輝達盤中股價上漲2.09%，每股暫報235.68美元；市值暫報5.68兆美元。
據《彭博》報導，輝達先前因市場擔憂人工智慧(AI)前景，歷經兩個月賣壓，市值一度蒸發逾1兆美元。近期隨著AI代理應用帶動晶片需求的期待升高，加上公司擴大股票回購，股價重拾漲勢。
Meta(META-US)旗下Muse等AI代理服務，被市場視為可能推升半導體需求的新動力。輝達周一另宣布，將股票回購計畫增加1,500億美元，新增規模創公司紀錄，進一步提振投資人信心。
不過，輝達這波反彈也反映AI產業情緒快速變化。過去幾個月，市場持續質疑企業投入數千億美元建置AI基礎設施的效益，也愈來愈關注先進AI可能對人類帶來的安全風險。
為回應相關疑慮，輝達周一推出新的雙層AI安全系統，目標是防止AI代理失控。公司表示，這套系統原本可以阻止近期OpenAI模型入侵開源平台Hugging Face的事件。在投資人更加重視AI安全之際，這項措施也成為輝達近期布局的一環。
輝達今年以來股價累計上漲約27%，有望連續第四年繳出雙位數報酬。隨著市值逼近6兆美元，AI代理能否持續帶動晶片需求，以及企業龐大AI投資的前景，仍牽動市場對其成長潛力的評估。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) shares rose as much as 2.9% during Friday’s session (the 2nd), breaking the record set in May this year for the first time; its market value climbed to roughly $5.7 trillion, now less than $300 billion away from becoming the first company ever to reach a $6 trillion valuation. Investors poured back into the world’s most valuable listed firm, lifting the stock about 25% from its late‑July low.
At the time of writing, NVIDIA’s intraday price was up 2.09%, reporting a provisional $235.68 per share and a market cap of about $5.68 trillion.

According to Bloomberg, NVIDIA had previously faced market worries about the outlook for artificial intelligence (AI), enduring two months of selling pressure that erased more than $1 trillion in market value. Recently, rising expectations for chip demand driven by AI‑agent applications and an expanded share‑repurchase program have helped the stock regain its upward momentum.

Meta’s (META-US) AI‑agent services such as Muse are seen by the market as a potential new driver of semiconductor demand. On Monday, NVIDIA also announced an additional $150 billion to its share‑repurchase plan, the largest increase in the company’s history, further bolstering investor confidence.

However, this rally also reflects the rapid shifts in sentiment toward the AI industry. In recent months, the market has continued to question the value of companies spending tens of billions of dollars to build AI infrastructure and has grown increasingly concerned about the safety risks that advanced AI could pose to humanity.

In response to those concerns, NVIDIA launched a new two‑layer AI safety system on Monday aimed at preventing AI agents from going out of control. The company said the system could have blocked the recent incident in which an OpenAI model attempted to infiltrate the open‑source platform Hugging Face. As investors place greater emphasis on AI safety, the measure has become part of NVIDIA’s recent strategic rollout.

Since the start of the year, NVIDIA’s stock has risen about 27%, positioning it for a fourth consecutive year of double‑digit returns. With market value edging toward $6 trillion, whether AI agents can sustain chip demand and the outlook for massive corporate AI spending will continue to shape market assessments of the company’s growth potential.

items.title: 油輪重返荷姆茲難救通膨！布蘭特油價破百 煉油瓶頸加劇美債拋售潮
items.title_en: Oil Tankers Return to the Hormuz Strait Fails to Ease Inflation! Brent Crude Breaks $100, Refining Bottlenecks Intensify US Treasury Sell‑off
paras: 油輪重返荷姆茲海峽，原本應該有助於壓低原油、汽油與柴油價格，進而抑制通膨並降低全球借貸成本，但目前情況並非如此：供應鏈將原油轉化為燃料的環節仍遭受衝擊，持續推高能源價格，助長美債賣壓。
在美軍削弱伊朗對荷姆茲海峽控制的情況下，石油運輸量逐漸回升至接近戰前水準，但作為全球原油期貨基準的布蘭特原油周四(1日)仍大漲4.4%至每桶102.31美元。由美國汽車協會(AAA)追蹤的美國汽油平均價格仍維持在每加侖4.41美元以上。10年期美債殖利率本周則升至24年來最高水準。
華爾街日報(WSJ)報導，導致債券殖利率居高不下的因素，來自多項彼此交織的威脅，而這些因素正持續擠壓石油市場：

荷姆茲海峽的船舶通行量預估分歧很大，交易員擔心局勢再度升溫，隨時可能讓供應量大幅下降。
葉門胡塞武裝(Houthi)持續威脅阿拉伯半島周邊同樣運輸石油的航線。
距離中東數千英里之外，烏克蘭持續發動空襲，鎖定俄羅斯煉油廠，而俄羅斯煉油廠過去一直是供應柴油給許多工業經濟體的重要來源。


這些因素推高了原油運輸與燃料加工成本，進而提高汽車、卡車、商用飛機及農業設備等各類交通與生產工具的營運成本。

荷姆茲運輸恢復 成品油供應仍吃緊

這項瓶頸正讓美國通膨受到後續衝擊，影響可能持續到11月期中選舉之後，並迫使聯準會(Fed)考慮未來數月進一步升息。與此同時，債券市場早就難以消化人工智慧(AI)相關債務大量湧現、龐大的財政赤字，以及足以讓通膨持續超標的強勁經濟。
10年期美債殖利率周四雖然稍稍回落至5.233%，但在周三為止的一季創下1994年以來最大單季升幅，並推動美國房貸利率突破7%。
瑞銀投資銀行(UBS Investment Bank)全球經濟與策略主管Arend Kapteyn說：「目前市場對美國與伊朗是否朝某種正式協議取得進展，以及局勢是否可能進一步中斷供應，仍高度敏感。從央行的角度來看，不能只關注原油，還要關注(煉製)成品油，而成品油市場非常吃緊。」

庫存緩衝大減

目前美國海軍逐漸削弱伊朗攻擊油輪或附近能源設施的能力，在戰爭開打八個月後，波斯灣產油國與航運公司也愈來愈擅長抵禦或躲避攻擊。摩根士丹利(Morgan Stanley)分析師預估，中東原油出口量近期如今僅比戰前水準低7%。
但考量到許多油輪關閉追蹤系統，或在船與船之間轉移貨物以降低遭到攻擊的風險，其他分析師對航運恢復程度仍抱持審慎態度。
伊朗在葉門的代理人胡塞武裝再次攻擊區域航線，也促使交易員在持有部位納入更高的風險溢價，進而支撐能源價格。
伊朗戰爭爆發至今，市場一直靠從中國、歐洲到美國的庫存提供緩衝，但如今庫存已大幅下降，需要重新補充，而且幾乎沒有犯錯的空間。這種不確定性讓交易員緊盯美國與中國可能限制燃料出口的消息。

中東成品油出口比戰前低40%

儘管原油期貨價格已從近期高點回落，但實體原油貨物的價格仍維持高檔，顯示煉油商爭相鎖定短期供應。用來追蹤即期交割的基準價格、北海現貨原油價格是周四報每桶127.42美元。
CIBC Private Wealth資深能源交易員Rebecca Babin說：「無論數據顯示有多少原油正經過荷姆茲海峽，市場的需求顯然仍存在。」
摩根大通(JP Morgan)預估，中東汽油、柴油與航空燃油等成品油出口量，目前仍比戰前水準低約40%。

原油進入市場成本大增

還要考慮一點：油輪運輸量雖然回升，但原油進入市場的成本也大幅飆升。從波斯灣向西航行的油輪，有時必須繞行非洲南端，以避開胡塞武裝的攻擊威脅。此外，許多航運公司會將石油從波斯灣運往荷姆茲海峽外圍，再在當地轉運給前往其他目的地的船隻。
這些因素占用了全球大量超大型油輪運力，並推高運費。根據Argus數據，從中東運送原油至中國的超大型油輪，近期一趟約21天的航程，成本相當於每桶35美元，而戰爭爆發前一天的成本還不到每桶7美元。

中東煉油產能下降 柴油與原油價差創紀錄

當原油抵達煉油廠後，成本壓力又進一步擴大。由於中東煉油產能下降，加上烏克蘭攻擊俄羅斯煉油廠，促使莫斯科限制柴油出口，交易員願意向其他仍有能力大量生產燃料的企業支付溢價。
在紐約，柴油期貨近期價格約為原油價格的兩倍，柴油與原油之間的價差遠超過過去任何紀錄，推升加油站的批發成本。
許多能源業高層預料這種情況將持續。達拉斯聯準銀行本周公布的調查顯示，48%的受訪者認為，柴油價格與原油成本之間的價差至少需要一年才會恢復至2025年水準，約36%的受訪者對汽油價差也持相同看法。

殖利率仍可能走高

美國企業在年初或戰爭爆發後初期鎖定的部分避險成本，如今即將到期，讓農民、居家修繕商店及卡車業者等企業正面臨艱難抉擇。
U.S. Bank商品團隊主管Charlie Macnamara指出，目前較高的價格「將開始滲透到這些企業的避險計畫中，最終也會傳導至終端消費者」。
儘管能源價格仍處於令人難以承受的高檔，分析師認為，能源價格目前還沒有高到足以迫使經濟大幅放緩的程度，尤其美國經濟仍受到人工智慧(AI)熱潮與創歷史新高的股市支撐。
Principal Asset Management首席全球策略師Seema Shah說：「如果經濟韌性與投資需求持續，殖利率可能仍有進一步走高的空間。」
paras_en: Oil tankers have returned to the Hormuz Strait, which should have helped lower crude, gasoline and diesel prices and thus curb inflation and reduce global borrowing costs, but that is not the case: the supply‑chain link that turns crude into fuel is still under pressure, keeping energy prices high and feeding the sell‑off in US Treasuries.

With US forces weakening Iran’s control of the Hormuz Strait, oil shipments are gradually climbing back toward pre‑war levels, yet Brent crude – the global benchmark – jumped 4.4% on Thursday the 1st to $102.31 a barrel. The average US gasoline price tracked by the American Automobile Association (AAA) remains above $4.41 per gallon, and 10‑year US Treasury yields this week rose to their highest level in 24 years.
The Wall Street Journal reported that the forces keeping bond yields elevated stem from a web of inter‑linked threats that are also squeezing the oil market.

Estimates of ship traffic through the Hormuz Strait vary widely, and traders fear a resurgence of tension could sharply cut supplies. Houthi rebels in Yemen continue to threaten oil‑carrying routes around the Arabian Peninsula. Thousands of miles away, Ukraine keeps launching air strikes on Russian refineries, which have long been a key diesel source for many industrial economies.

The bottleneck is feeding back into US inflation and could affect the market through the November mid‑term elections, forcing the Federal Reserve to consider further rate hikes in the coming months. At the same time, the bond market has long struggled to absorb a flood of AI‑related debt, massive fiscal deficits and a robust economy that keeps inflation above target.
Although 10‑year Treasury yields slipped slightly to 5.233% on Thursday, they had set the biggest quarterly gain since 1994 by Wednesday and pushed US mortgage rates past 7%.

Arend Kapteyn, global economics and strategy head at UBS Investment Bank, said: “The market remains highly sensitive to any progress toward a formal agreement between the US and Iran or to any further supply disruptions. From a central‑bank perspective you can’t just watch crude; you have to watch refined products, and the refined‑product market is extremely tight.”

Inventory buffers have shrunk dramatically. The US Navy is gradually reducing Iran’s ability to attack tankers or nearby energy facilities, and eight months into the war, Persian Gulf producers and shipping firms have become more adept at evading or defending against attacks. Morgan Stanley analysts estimate that Middle‑East crude exports are now only about 7% below pre‑war levels.
However, because many tankers have disabled tracking systems or are transshipping cargo between vessels to lower attack risk, other analysts remain cautious about how fully shipping has recovered.
Iran’s Houthi proxies in Yemen have again struck regional routes, prompting traders to price a higher risk premium into their positions and thereby supporting energy prices.

Since the war began, markets have relied on inventories from China, Europe and the US for buffering, but those stocks have now fallen sharply, need replenishment and leave almost no margin for error. This uncertainty has traders watching closely for any news that the US or China might restrict fuel exports.

Middle‑East refined‑product exports are about 40% lower than before the war. Although crude futures have retreated from recent peaks, spot physical crude prices remain high, showing refiners scrambling for short‑term supply. The benchmark spot price for North Sea crude was $127.42 a barrel on Thursday.
Rebecca Babin, a senior energy trader at CIBC Private Wealth, said: “No matter how much crude the data show moving through the Hormuz Strait, demand in the market is clearly still there.”
JP Morgan estimates that Middle‑East exports of gasoline, diesel and jet fuel are still roughly 40% below pre‑war levels.

The cost of getting crude into the market has surged. Even though tanker volumes are rising, ships sailing west from the Persian Gulf sometimes have to detour around the southern tip of Africa to avoid Houthi attacks. Many carriers also move oil from the Gulf to the outer Hormuz area before transshipping to vessels bound for other destinations.

These practices tie up a large share of the world’s ultra‑large crude tanker capacity and lift freight rates. Argus data show that a recent 21‑day voyage from the Middle East to China now costs about $35 per barrel, versus less than $7 per barrel the day before the war started.

Middle‑East refining capacity has fallen, widening the diesel‑to‑crude spread to record levels. With reduced refining in the region and Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries prompting Moscow to curb diesel exports, traders are willing to pay premiums to firms that can still produce fuel in large volumes.
In New York, diesel futures are currently trading at roughly twice the price of crude, a spread that far exceeds any historical record and pushes up wholesale costs for gas stations.

Many energy executives expect this situation to persist. A Dallas Fed survey this week found that 48% of respondents think the diesel‑crude spread will not return to 2025 levels for at least a year, and about 36% hold the same view for the gasoline spread.

Yield pressures may keep rising. Hedging costs that US companies locked in early in the year or shortly after the war began are now expiring, leaving farmers, home‑improvement retailers and trucking firms facing tough choices.
Charlie Macnamara, head of the commodities team at U.S. Bank, said higher prices “will start to seep into these companies’ hedging programs and ultimately be passed on to end consumers.”

Even though energy prices remain painfully high, analysts say they are not yet high enough to force a sharp economic slowdown, especially as the US economy is still buoyed by the AI boom and record‑high equity markets.
Seema Shah, chief global strategist at Principal Asset Management, warned: “If economic resilience and investment demand persist, yields could still have room to move higher.”

items.title: 連兩年下滑後有轉機？特斯拉Q3交車勝預期 分析師看好全年銷量
items.title_en: Is There a Turnaround After Two Years of Decline? Tesla Q3 Deliveries Beat Expectations, Analysts Optimistic About Full-Year Sales
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)周五(2日)公布，第三季全球交車量達48萬6,532輛，優於華爾街預期，顯示核心汽車業務在連續兩年銷量下滑後，開始出現回穩跡象。歐洲需求復甦，抵銷美國購車稅務優惠取消及中國競爭加劇的部分壓力，帶動股價早盤上漲。
綜合外媒報導，特斯拉交車量高於《彭博》彙整的46萬3,761輛平均預估，也超過Visible Alpha調查的45萬6,896輛。截至紐約時間上午9時34分，股價上漲4%；不過，截至前一交易日，今年累計仍下跌逾21%。
截稿前，特斯拉(TSLA-US)周五盤中股價上漲5.44%，每股暫報373.37美元。

交車優於預期 全年有望終結連兩年下滑

第三季交車量仍低於去年同期的49萬7,099輛，年減約2.1%。去年同期因美國消費者趕在聯邦購車優惠取消前購車，創下季度交車紀錄，墊高比較基期。
今年第三季Model 3與Model Y合計交付47萬8,237輛，其餘車款僅8,295輛，顯示兩款主力車仍占絕大多數銷量。同期產量為46萬4,391輛，低於市場預估的48萬6,761輛。
特斯拉第四季至少需交付31萬1,448輛，才能避免全年交車量連續第三年下滑。分析師已將2026年全年預估由6月的165萬輛上修至182萬輛，反映需求前景改善。
歐洲是主要支撐。特斯拉去年因馬斯克政治立場引發反彈而銷售受挫，今年前八個月歐盟新車掛牌量則成長66%，8月成長約53%。Model Y更成為法國單月最暢銷車款，首次有特斯拉車型登上該榜首。
上海廠7、8月出口量也接近翻倍，協助抵銷中國市場競爭壓力。分析師預期，已獲歐洲八國批准的全自動輔助駕駛(FSD)軟體，隨部署推進可望進一步支持銷售。

AI布局仍牽動估值 汽車業務提供營收支撐

儘管馬斯克持續將投資人焦點轉向AI、自動駕駛與Optimus人形機器人，汽車仍是特斯拉最大的營收來源。公司約1.4兆美元估值高度仰賴長期願景，季度交車仍是檢視核心業務的重要指標。
特斯拉在德州與佛州的自駕計程車服務，已不再配置車內安全監督員，上月也將專用車款Cybercab加入奧斯汀營運。不過，服務規模仍小於Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Waymo。
公司今年計劃支出逾250億美元，擴建工廠並發展自駕計程車業務，本周文件另揭露，已取得300億美元新貸款與信用額度。
能源業務方面，第三季儲能部署量達13.7GWh，高於去年同期的12.5GWh及第二季的13.5GWh。汽車與儲能表現改善，但龐大投資能否轉化為持續成長，仍是後續觀察重點。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) announced on Friday the 2nd that its global deliveries for the third quarter reached 486,532 vehicles, surpassing Wall Street forecasts and indicating that the core automotive business is showing signs of stabilizing after two consecutive years of sales declines. A recovery in European demand offset some pressure from the removal of U.S. purchase tax incentives and heightened competition in China, lifting the stock in early trading.

According to foreign media reports, Tesla's deliveries exceeded Bloomberg's consensus estimate of 463,761 vehicles and also beat Visible Alpha's forecast of 456,896 units. By 9:34 a.m. New York time, the share price was up 4%, though it remains down more than 21% for the year as of the previous trading day.
Just before the deadline, Tesla (TSLA-US) saw its intraday price rise 5.44% on Friday, briefly trading at $373.37 per share.

Deliveries beat expectations, raising hopes that the full year could finally end the two‑year decline. Third‑quarter deliveries were still below last year’s 497,099, a year‑over‑year drop of about 2.1%. Last year’s figure was boosted by U.S. consumers rushing to buy before the federal purchase incentive expired, setting a record quarterly delivery that raised the comparison base.

In the third quarter, Model 3 and Model Y together accounted for 478,237 deliveries, with the remaining models totaling only 8,295 units, showing that the two flagship models still dominate sales. Production for the period was 464,391, below the market estimate of 486,761.

Tesla will need to deliver at least 311,448 vehicles in the fourth quarter to avoid a third consecutive year of overall delivery declines. Analysts have raised their 2026 full‑year estimate from 1.65 million units in June to 1.82 million, reflecting an improving demand outlook.

Europe is the main support. After a sales dip last year due to backlash over Elon Musk’s political stance, new‑car registrations in the EU grew 66% in the first eight months of this year, with August alone up about 53%. The Model Y even became France’s best‑selling car for a month, the first time a Tesla model has topped the chart there.

Exports from the Shanghai plant in July and August nearly doubled, helping to offset competitive pressure in the Chinese market. Analysts expect that the fully autonomous driving (FSD) software, already approved in eight European countries, will further boost sales as deployment progresses.

AI initiatives still drive valuation, but the automotive business provides revenue support. Although Musk continues to shift investor focus toward AI, autonomous driving and the Optimus humanoid robot, cars remain Tesla’s biggest revenue source. The company’s roughly $1.4 trillion valuation heavily relies on its long‑term vision, and quarterly deliveries remain a key gauge of core business health.

Tesla’s autonomous‑taxi services in Texas and Florida no longer staff safety monitors inside the vehicles, and last month added the dedicated Cybercab model to its Austin fleet. However, the service scale remains smaller than Alphabet’s (GOOGL-US) Waymo.

The company plans to spend over $25 billion this year expanding factories and developing autonomous‑taxi operations, and documents released this week revealed it has secured a new $30 billion loan and credit facility.

In its energy segment, third‑quarter energy storage deployments reached 13.7 GWh, higher than 12.5 GWh in the same quarter last year and 13.5 GWh in the second quarter. While automotive and storage performance have improved, whether the massive investments can translate into sustained growth remains a key focus for the future.

items.title: 川普施壓後達協議！G7將釋出最多1億桶原油與柴油救油價
items.title_en: Trump Pressures Lead to Deal! G7 to Release Up to 100 Million Barrels of Crude Oil and Diesel to Ease Prices
paras: 七大工業國集團(G7)將在未來四個月釋出最多1億桶原油與柴油緊急庫存，以緩解燃料價格高漲。法國總統馬克宏周五(2日)表示，行動將由國際能源署(IEA)協調，各國也承諾避免實施出口禁令。此前，美國曾以禁止柴油出口施壓，要求歐洲加快釋出庫存。
綜合外媒報導，美國總統川普同日宣布，歐洲已同意釋出「大量」柴油庫存，並將立即啟動程序。這項協議降低美方祭出柴油出口禁令的可能性，也有助緩和歐洲與拉丁美洲面臨的供應風險。

G7四個月釋出最多1億桶 原油與柴油庫存同步動用

目前擔任G7輪值主席的馬克宏在記者簡報會上表示，各國將於未來四個月釋出最多1億桶緊急石油與柴油庫存，希望藉由增加供應，促使燃料價格下降。這個數字是原油與柴油的合計上限，並非全數為柴油。
川普則在Truth Social發文表示：「歐洲剛同意釋出大量、儲備充足的柴油庫存，程序將立即開始。」他未提供釋出數量等進一步細節，但對這項行動表示歡迎。
柴油價格近期觸及歷史高點，川普政府希望在11月期中選舉前壓低燃料成本，因而要求歐洲增加市場供應。美方此前提出，若歐洲國家不釋出更多庫存，可能禁止美國柴油出口。
IEA已在3月美伊戰爭爆發後不久，協調釋出4億桶戰略石油儲備。不過，川普曾批評歐洲未能足夠迅速地將這些油品投入市場，新一輪行動則將釋出重點放在柴油。

各國承諾避免出口禁令 柴油溢價應聲下滑

馬克宏表示，各國已共同承諾按協議釋出戰略儲備，並以柴油為重點，同時確保不會實施出口禁令。他強調，川普對這一點尤其表達了明確立場。
歐洲柴油產量不足，必須大量仰賴進口，美國是重要供應來源。一旦美方禁止出口，將威脅歐洲取得柴油的管道，也可能造成全球供應緊縮，對歐洲與拉丁美洲經濟帶來重大衝擊。
隨著交易員將新增供應納入預期，柴油相對原油的溢價明顯下滑。這項衡量柴油市場強弱的重要指標回落，反映市場對短期供應緊張的疑慮有所緩和。
paras_en: The Group of Seven (G7) industrialized nations will release up to 100 million barrels of emergency crude oil and diesel inventories over the next four months to ease soaring fuel prices. French President Emmanuel Macron said on Friday (the 2nd) that the operation will be coordinated by the International Energy Agency (IEA), and the countries have also pledged not to impose export bans. Earlier, the United States had pressured Europe by threatening to ban diesel exports unless Europe accelerated the release of its stockpiles.

According to a compilation of foreign media reports, U.S. President Donald Trump announced the same day that Europe had agreed to release a “large” amount of diesel inventories and that the process would be launched immediately. The agreement reduces the likelihood of the United States imposing a diesel export ban and helps ease the supply‑risk pressures facing Europe and Latin America.

The G7 will release up to 100 million barrels of crude oil and diesel inventories over four months, using both stocks simultaneously. Acting G7 chair Macron told reporters that the nations will release up to 100 million barrels of emergency oil and diesel stock over the next four months, hoping that the added supply will push fuel prices lower. The figure is a combined ceiling for crude and diesel, not all diesel.

Trump wrote on Truth Social: “Europe has just agreed to release a large, well‑stocked diesel inventory, and the process will start immediately.” He did not provide details on the quantity to be released but welcomed the action.

Diesel prices have recently hit historic highs, and the Trump administration wants to lower fuel costs before the November mid‑term elections, prompting it to ask Europe to increase market supply. The United States had previously warned that if European countries did not release more stockpiles, it might ban U.S. diesel exports.

The IEA coordinated the release of 400 million barrels of strategic petroleum reserves shortly after the March outbreak of the U.S.–Iran war. However, Trump criticized Europe for not moving those oil supplies into the market quickly enough, and the new round of action will focus on diesel.

The countries have pledged to avoid export bans, and diesel premiums are expected to fall. Macron said the nations have jointly committed to release strategic reserves under the agreement, with diesel as the focus, while ensuring no export bans are imposed. He stressed that Trump has made his position on this point especially clear.

Europe’s diesel production is insufficient and it must rely heavily on imports, with the United States being a key supplier. If the United States were to ban exports, Europe’s diesel supply channels would be threatened, potentially tightening global supply and delivering a major economic shock to Europe and Latin America.

As traders incorporate the new supply into their expectations, the diesel‑to‑crude price premium has slipped noticeably. This key gauge of diesel market strength has retreated, reflecting a easing of concerns over short‑term supply tightness.

items.title: 非農爆冷為何股市歡呼？華爾街：最怕Fed升息太快
items.title_en: Why a Cold Nonfarm Payroll Report Sent the Stock Market Cheering? Wall Street: Most Worried About the Fed Raising Rates Too Quickly
paras: 美國9月非農就業不如預期，華爾街分析師普遍認為，這份報告讓聯準會(Fed)有更多理由在10月暫停升息，也減輕市場對政策收緊過快的疑慮。不過，部分人士仍預期12月再升息一次，並提醒薪資降溫可能壓抑消費，招聘疲弱也值得持續追蹤。
美國勞工統計局(BLS)周五(2日)公布，9月非農僅新增2.9萬人，失業率升至4.2%，帶動股債反彈。分析師關注的重點，在於這份數據如何改變Fed政策空間，以及近期集中於少數股票的漲勢，能否擴散至更多類股。

壞消息成市場利多 分析師憂Fed升息過快

PenderFund Capital Management投資長Greg Taylor表示，市場原本擔心Fed10月還得再升息，但這份數據在他看來，已讓本月升息的可能性退出考量。12月仍可能升息，不過市場已充分反映，預料衝擊較小。
Orion投資長Tim Holland也認為，華爾街再次出現「壞消息就是好消息」的反應。投資人理解Fed面對偏高通膨，需要維持鷹派立場，但也擔心升息幅度過大、速度過快。就業報告替Fed爭取更多觀察時間，因此受到市場歡迎。
CrossCheck Management投資長Todd Schoenberger指出，近期債市殖利率上升，已自行發揮類似Fed緊縮政策的效果；較弱的就業與薪資數據，則有助暫時緩解通膨疑慮。但他提醒，股市慶祝這份報告的同時，一般民眾仍有理由擔心就業成長。

漲勢有望擴散 信用市場壓力仍須留意

Great Hill Capital董事長Thomas Hayes認為，這份報告可能改變市場格局。過去兩個月，漲勢集中於五至十檔股票，如今則出現更廣泛的買盤，先前乏人問津的大部分股票開始回升，有利於市場健康。
他表示，數據讓Fed有理由10月暫停升息、等待更多通膨資訊，也可能減輕企業與房屋融資、再融資的負擔。他並警告，若持續升息使殖利率曲線走向倒掛，可能增加後續衰退風險；前月就業下修是否形成趨勢，也應讓Fed避免過快收緊政策。
Integrated Partners投資長Stephen Kolano則提醒，勞動市場雖仍穩定，部分信用市場已開始承壓，尤其信用評等較低的高收益債利差擴大。
隨著大型雲端業者增加發債，他認為Fed可能更審慎升息，以免打亂AI資本支出，同時觀察市場利率上升是否已足以抑制通膨。

就業仍有韌性 薪資降溫也可能拖累消費

Natixis首席美國經濟學家Christopher Hodge認為，9月數據雖令人失望，但較像既有趨勢正常化，整體勞動市場仍穩健，只是表現不突出。他將勞動參與率上升視為正面訊號，認為這也是失業率小幅攀升的原因。
Spartan Capital Securities首席市場經濟學家Peter Cardillo也表示，就業仍在成長，且沒有明顯薪資通膨壓力。搭配近期低於預期的個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數，這份報告支持Fed10月維持利率不變，也可能緩和殖利率升勢。
富國銀行(WFC-US)投資研究所全球策略師Gary Schlossberg指出，家庭調查就業人數大增，但勞動人口增加更多，使失業率上升，掩蓋了這項調查中的就業強度。
不過，他提醒，薪資通膨連續三個月放緩，可能對家庭購買力形成壓力，讓8月強勁的消費動能在9月減弱。這份報告也可能反映經濟進入第四季時，動能有所流失。

10月暫停呼聲升高 12月升息仍在考量

高盛(GS-US)資產管理多元固定收益投資主管Lindsay Rosner表示，10月升息看來不太可能，因為疲弱數據不支持勞動市場重新收緊的說法。她的基本預測仍是12月再升息一次，但市場壓力與能源價格進一步上漲，也可能迫使Fed本月採取行動。
Annex Wealth Management首席經濟策略師Brian Jacobsen則認為，勞動市場沒有原先想像中強勁。7月就業再次下修為負成長，8月反彈後，9月增幅又明顯萎縮。
他特別指出，反映就業成長廣度的擴散指數再度跌破50，顯示招聘成長不夠普遍。Fed主席華許先前關注通膨擴散，如今也必須考量就業成長廣度不足，這支持10月暫停升息。
paras_en: U.S. September nonfarm payrolls missed expectations, and Wall Street analysts broadly believe the report gives the Federal Reserve more reason to pause rate hikes in October, easing market concerns about tightening policy too quickly. Still, some expect another hike in December and warn that cooling wages could suppress consumption, while weak hiring merits continued monitoring.

The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics released on Friday the 2nd that September added only 29,000 jobs, with the unemployment rate rising to 4.2%, sparking a rebound in stocks and bonds. Analysts are focused on how the data changes the Fed's policy space and whether the recent rally concentrated in a few stocks can spread to a broader range of equities.

Bad news turned into market good news, analysts worry about the Fed raising rates too fast. Greg Taylor, CIO of PenderFund Capital Management, said the market was originally worried the Fed would need another hike in October, but this data, in his view, removes that possibility from consideration. A December hike remains possible, but the market has already priced it in, so the impact should be modest.

Orion CIO Tim Holland also noted that Wall Street again displayed the “bad news is good news” reaction. Investors understand the Fed must stay hawkish in the face of elevated inflation, yet they fear rate hikes that are too large or too rapid. The jobs report gives the Fed more time to observe, which the market welcomed.

Todd Schoenberger, CIO of CrossCheck Management, pointed out that recent bond‑yield rises have already acted like a Fed tightening, and weaker employment and wage data help temporarily ease inflation worries. He cautioned, however, that while the market celebrates the report, the general public still has reasons to worry about job growth.

Thomas Hayes, chairman of Great Hill Capital, said the report could shift market dynamics. In the past two months the rally was confined to five‑to‑ten stocks; now buying is spreading more broadly, with many previously ignored stocks rebounding, which is healthy for the market.

He added that the data give the Fed a reason to pause hikes in October and wait for more inflation information, potentially easing corporate and mortgage‑refinancing burdens. He warned that continued hikes could invert the yield curve, raising recession risk, and that the prior month’s employment downgrade might signal a trend the Fed should heed to avoid tightening too quickly.

Stephen Kolano, CIO of Integrated Partners, warned that while the labor market remains stable, parts of the credit market are already under pressure, especially high‑yield spreads widening for lower‑rated issuers.

As large cloud providers increase debt issuance, he believes the Fed may become more cautious about raising rates to avoid disrupting AI‑related capital spending, while watching whether higher market rates are already sufficient to curb inflation.

Christopher Hodge, chief U.S. economist at Natixis, said September’s data were disappointing but reflected a normalization of existing trends, with the overall labor market still robust though not spectacular. He viewed the rise in labor‑force participation as a positive sign and a factor behind the modest uptick in unemployment.

Peter Cardillo, chief market economist at Spartan Capital Securities, also noted that employment is still growing without clear wage‑inflation pressure. Coupled with the recently lower‑than‑expected personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index, the report supports a pause in Fed rate hikes in October and could temper the rise in yields.

Gary Schlossberg, global strategist at Wells Fargo’s investment research, pointed out that while household survey job numbers surged, a larger increase in the labor force pushed the unemployment rate higher, masking the underlying employment strength in the survey.

He cautioned, however, that three consecutive months of slowing wage inflation could pressure household purchasing power, weakening the strong consumer momentum seen in August during September. The report may also signal that economic momentum is fading as the fourth quarter approaches.

Lindsay Rosner, head of multi‑asset fixed‑income investing at Goldman Sachs Asset Management, said an October hike looks unlikely because weak data do not support a renewed tightening of the labor market. Her baseline forecast remains a December hike, though market pressure and further energy‑price rises could force the Fed to act this month.

Brian Jacobsen, chief economic strategist at Annex Wealth Management, argued that the labor market is not as strong as previously thought. July employment was revised down into negative growth, and after an August rebound, September’s gain shrank markedly.

He highlighted that the diffusion index measuring the breadth of job growth fell below 50 again, indicating that hiring is not widespread. Fed Chair Jerome Powell, who previously focused on inflation diffusion, now must also consider the insufficient breadth of employment growth, supporting a pause in October hikes.

items.title: 3檔處置股下周一抓去關 準千金股大量遭處置至10/12
items.title_en: Three Stocks to Be Disposed Starting Next Monday, Da Liang Stock Heavily Disposed Until Oct 12
paras: 證交所及櫃買中心今(2)日公告3檔新增處置股，包括上市股大量(3167-TW)、高力(8996-TW)及上櫃生技股浩鼎(4174-TW)等處置股，全數均採2分鐘撮合交易，處置期間皆自下周一(10月5日)起處置到10月12日止。
大量遭處置原因為今日之本益比為68.79，且股價淨值比為20.45。另當日周轉率為7.46%，且其股價淨值比較該類股股價淨值比四倍以上。
高力處置原因為今日本益比為101.68，且股價淨值比為27.42；另今日周轉率為6.26%，且其股價淨值比較該類股股價淨值比四倍以上。
浩鼎處置原因為最近6個營業日(含當日)累積之最後成交價漲幅達36.68%，今日之成交量較最近60個營業日，日平均成交量放大8.81倍。
PCB設備專業廠大量累計今(2026)年1-8月合併營收為71.72億元、年增率達135.15%，受惠高階半導體、PCB設備出貨暢旺。法人預估大量營收有望持續成功創新高，下半年度有望優於上半年。
大量今日在外資、投信連2買支援下，小漲0.62%，盤中一度衝破千元，終場收981元。
paras_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange and the GreTai Securities Market announced today (the 2nd) three newly designated disposal stocks, including listed stock Da Liang (3167-TW), Gao Li (8996-TW), and OTC biotech stock Hao Ding (4174-TW). All will be traded via a 2‑minute matching auction, and the disposal period runs from next Monday (October 5) through October 12.

The reason for Da Liang's disposal is that its price‑earnings ratio today was 68.79 and its price‑to‑book ratio was 20.45. The turnover rate that day was 7.46%, and its price‑to‑book ratio is more than four times the average price‑to‑book ratio of its peer group.

The reason for Gao Li's disposal is that its price‑earnings ratio today was 101.68 and its price‑to‑book ratio was 27.42; the turnover rate was 6.26%, and its price‑to‑book ratio is more than four times that of its peer group.

The reason for Hao Ding's disposal is that over the most recent six trading days (including today) the cumulative increase in the last transaction price reached 36.68%, and today's trading volume was 8.81 times the average daily volume of the past 60 trading days.

PCB equipment specialist Da Liang reported cumulative consolidated revenue of NT$7.172 billion for January–August 2026, a year‑over‑year growth of 135.15%, benefiting from strong shipments of high‑end semiconductors and PCB equipment. Analysts forecast that the robust revenue is likely to continue setting new highs, and the second half of the year is expected to outperform the first half.
Da Liang rose 0.62% today, supported by foreign investors and investment trusts buying in two consecutive sessions; it briefly broke the NT$1,000 mark intraday and closed at NT$981.

items.title: 非農爆冷救美債！2年期美債殖利率跳水 Fed本月不升息機率破8成
items.title_en: Cold Nonfarm Payrolls Boost US Treasuries! 2-Year Yield Plunges, Fed's September Rate Hike Odds Fall Below 20%
paras: 美國9月非農就業遠遜預期，失業率也上升，促使債券交易員削減聯準會(Fed)本月升息押注，帶動美債價格周五(2日)上漲、殖利率下滑。對政策最敏感的2年期美債殖利率一度下跌10個基點至4.69%，10年期則一度跌8個基點至5.15%。
綜合外媒報導，利率交換市場反映的10月升息機率，由數據公布前近30%降至約20%，也不再完全反映年底前升息一次。芝商所(CME-US)FedWatch工具的另一時點數據則顯示，10月按兵不動機率升至84%。不過，分析師提醒，通膨與能源價格仍可能改變政策走向。

非農疲弱推升美債 空單回補可能放大漲勢

美國勞工統計局(BLS)公布，9月非農新增2.9萬人，不及《彭博》調查中的所有預測；失業率由4.1%升至4.2%，前兩個月就業數據也遭下修。
另一時點報價顯示，10年期美債殖利率下跌近6個基點至5.18%，2年期跌6個基點至4.73%，30年期跌3個基點至5.57%。10年期殖利率本周才觸及2002年以來最高水準。
規模達32兆美元的美債市場此前遭遇數月賣壓，原因包括能源價格推升通膨、AI基礎設施投資支撐經濟，以及美國財政疑慮。交易員在殖利率攀升期間累積空頭部位，如今若回補，可能進一步放大債券漲勢。
基金經理人James Athey認為，這份報告讓Fed10月升息的可能性大幅降低，也使他對看好債券的立場更有信心。

10月升息理由減弱 12月仍可能再升一次

美國世紀投資全球固定收益投資長Charles Tan表示，數據讓Fed更有理由維持利率不變，但只要接下來一、兩份通膨數據偏熱，政策預期就可能重新轉鷹。
高盛(GS-US)資產管理多元固定收益投資主管Lindsay Rosner指出，疲弱數據不支持勞動市場重新收緊的看法，其基本預測仍是12月再升息一次；但金融市場壓力與能源價格上漲，也可能迫使Fed本月採取行動。
Fed在主席華許領導下，上月完成2023年以來首次升息。副主席傑佛森與紐約Fed總裁威廉斯本周已表示，可以等待更多數據；達拉斯Fed總裁蘿根則認為仍需升息，但高美債殖利率也有助抑制經濟。
美國數據也帶動歐洲與英國升息押注降溫，市場預期歐洲央行升息次數由三次偏向兩次，英國央行則由四次偏向三次。主要歐洲經濟體10年期公債殖利率下跌約3個基點，油價回落也緩和了債市壓力。
paras_en: US September nonfarm payrolls fell far short of expectations and the unemployment rate rose, prompting bond traders to cut bets on a Fed rate hike this month, lifting US Treasury prices on Friday the 2nd and pushing yields down. The policy‑sensitive 2‑year Treasury yield fell as much as 10 basis points to 4.69%, while the 10‑year slipped up to 8 basis points to 5.15%.

According to a roundup of foreign media, the probability of an October rate hike reflected in the interest‑rate swap market fell from nearly 30% before the data release to about 20%, and it no longer fully priced in a single hike before year‑end. CME‑US FedWatch data at another point showed the odds of holding steady in October rose to 84%. Analysts warned, however, that inflation and energy prices could still shift the policy path.

Weak nonfarm numbers lifted US Treasuries, and short‑covering could amplify the rally. The US Bureau of Labor Statistics reported that September added only 29,000 jobs, missing every Bloomberg poll forecast, and the unemployment rate rose from 4.1% to 4.2%; the employment figures for the prior two months were also revised down.

At another snapshot, the 10‑year Treasury yield fell nearly 6 basis points to 5.18%, the 2‑year slipped 6 basis points to 4.73%, and the 30‑year dropped 3 basis points to 5.57%. The 10‑year yield had only this week reached its highest level since 2002.

The $32 trillion US Treasury market had been under months of selling pressure, driven by energy‑price‑fueled inflation, AI‑related infrastructure investment supporting the economy, and US fiscal concerns. Traders built short positions as yields rose, and any covering now could further boost bond prices.
Fund manager James Athey said the report dramatically lowered the odds of an October Fed hike and gave him even more confidence in his bullish stance on bonds.

Weaker case for an October hike, but a December hike still possible. Charles Tan, head of global fixed‑income at Century Investment, said the data give the Fed more reason to keep rates unchanged, yet a one‑ or two‑month burst of hotter inflation could swing expectations back hawkish.

Lindsay Rosner, head of multi‑asset fixed income at Goldman Sachs Asset Management, noted that weak data do not support a view of a tightening labour market, and her baseline forecast remains a December rate hike; however, financial‑market stress and rising energy prices could force the Fed to act this month.

Under Chair Waller, the Fed delivered its first hike since 2023 last month. Vice‑Chair Jefferson and New York Fed President Williams said this week they can wait for more data, while Dallas Fed President Logan said a hike is still needed, though high Treasury yields also help curb the economy.

US data also cooled rate‑hike bets in Europe and the UK, with markets now expecting the ECB to raise rates twice rather than three times and the BoE twice rather than three or four times. Major European 10‑year sovereign yields fell about 3 basis points, and lower oil prices eased pressure on bond markets.

items.title: 3檔處置股下周一抓去關 準千金股大量遭處置至10/12
items.title_en: Three Stocks to Be Disposed Starting Next Monday, Da Liang Stock Heavily Disposed Until Oct 12
paras: 證交所及櫃買中心今(2)日公告3檔新增處置股，包括上市股大量(3167-TW)、高力(8996-TW)及上櫃生技股浩鼎(4174-TW)等處置股，全數均採2分鐘撮合交易，處置期間皆自下周一(10月5日)起處置到10月12日止。
大量遭處置原因為今日之本益比為68.79，且股價淨值比為20.45。另當日周轉率為7.46%，且其股價淨值比較該類股股價淨值比四倍以上。
高力處置原因為今日本益比為101.68，且股價淨值比為27.42；另今日周轉率為6.26%，且其股價淨值比較該類股股價淨值比四倍以上。
浩鼎處置原因為最近6個營業日(含當日)累積之最後成交價漲幅達36.68%，今日之成交量較最近60個營業日，日平均成交量放大8.81倍。
PCB設備專業廠大量累計今(2026)年1-8月合併營收為71.72億元、年增率達135.15%，受惠高階半導體、PCB設備出貨暢旺。法人預估大量營收有望持續成功創新高，下半年度有望優於上半年。
大量今日在外資、投信連2買支援下，小漲0.62%，盤中一度衝破千元，終場收981元。
paras_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange and the GreTai Securities Market announced today (the 2nd) three newly designated disposal stocks, including listed stock Da Liang (3167-TW), Gao Li (8996-TW), and OTC biotech stock Hao Ding (4174-TW). All will be traded via a 2‑minute matching auction, and the disposal period runs from next Monday (October 5) through October 12.

The reason for Da Liang's disposal is that its price‑earnings ratio today was 68.79 and its price‑to‑book ratio was 20.45. The turnover rate that day was 7.46%, and its price‑to‑book ratio is more than four times the average price‑to‑book ratio of its peer group.

The reason for Gao Li's disposal is that its price‑earnings ratio today was 101.68 and its price‑to‑book ratio was 27.42; the turnover rate was 6.26%, and its price‑to‑book ratio is more than four times that of its peer group.

The reason for Hao Ding's disposal is that over the most recent six trading days (including today) the cumulative increase in the last transaction price reached 36.68%, and today's trading volume was 8.81 times the average daily volume of the past 60 trading days.

PCB equipment specialist Da Liang reported cumulative consolidated revenue of NT$7.172 billion for January–August 2026, a year‑over‑year growth of 135.15%, benefiting from strong shipments of high‑end semiconductors and PCB equipment. Analysts forecast that the robust revenue is likely to continue setting new highs, and the second half of the year is expected to outperform the first half.
Da Liang rose 0.62% today, supported by foreign investors and investment trusts buying in two consecutive sessions; it briefly broke the NT$1,000 mark intraday and closed at NT$981.

items.title: 彭啓明：生物炭成AI與半導體減碳關鍵 將組「台灣隊」拚2030年移除百萬噸碳
items.title_en: Peng Chih-Ming: Biochar is Key to AI and Semiconductor Decarbonization, Forming a “Taiwan Team” to Remove One Million Tons of Carbon by 2030
paras: 環境部長彭啓明於中秋連假期間接受歐洲碳移除專業Podcast節目《The Carbon Removal Scoop》第100集特別節目專訪，向國際社會闡述台灣碳移除戰略。彭啓明宣示，台灣將秉持以終為始精神檢討改進現機制，目標於2030年達成每年100萬噸二氧化碳當量生物炭碳移除（Biochar Carbon Removal）規模。此舉可改善每年500萬噸農業剩餘資材價值，並結合綠色融資與跨國合作，為半導體與AI供應鏈提供高標碳移除方案，成為台灣邁向2050淨零碳排關鍵拼圖。
彭啓明指出，台灣每年產生約500萬噸農業剩餘資材，例如香蕉與鳳梨等作物殘體，過去多以焚化、堆肥處理，未能徹底發揮循環資源價值。為達成2030年百萬噸碳移除目標，環境部正積極與農業部跨部會合作，組成「生物炭台灣隊（Biochar Taiwan Team）」，推動沙盒試驗以加速建立本土方法學。
此外，面對全球半導體與AI供應鏈對高標碳移除迫切需求，生物炭具極高技術與經濟可行性，可望成為我國高科技產業進行綠色轉型關鍵助力。

在制度接軌方面，環境部將參考歐盟碳移除認證框架（CRCF）、歐洲生物炭認證（EBC）、日本農業生物炭策略及歐盟CRCF買方俱樂部（EU CRCF Buyers" Club）等經驗，建構與國際相容認證與交易機制。彭啓明強調，儘管台灣非《聯合國氣候變化綱要公約》締約方，但仍可依《巴黎協定》第6.2條雙邊合作精神積極拓展國際合作，目前我國已與巴拉圭簽署合作備忘錄，未來將於《巴黎協定》框架下共同推動生物炭與森林碳匯等專案，開啟我國參與全球氣候行動新契機。
針對國內具體實績與未來展望，中部已有業者收集科學園區廢木材製作生物炭並取得EBC認證，展現國內民間技術實力。環境部將整合農業部及相關部會並結合民間量能，提出國家級生物炭碳移除計畫，協調金融機構提供綠色融資，並推動生物炭延伸應用於土壤改良、營建材料等，擴大市場需求。
彭啓明表示，生物炭結合農業循環、碳定價與綠色金融，是台灣邁向2050淨零重要拼圖，環境部將持續與各部會及產學研界攜手，讓台灣在全球碳移除市場中扮演關鍵角色。
paras_en: During the Mid‑Autumn holiday, Environment Minister Peng Chih‑Ming was interviewed for the special 100th episode of the European carbon‑removal podcast “The Carbon Removal Scoop,” where he explained Taiwan’s carbon‑removal strategy to the international community. Peng declared that Taiwan will review and improve its current mechanisms with an end‑focused mindset, aiming to achieve an annual biochar carbon‑removal scale of one million tonnes of CO₂‑equivalent by 2030. This would add value to five million tonnes of agricultural residual materials each year, and, combined with green financing and cross‑border cooperation, provide high‑standard carbon‑removal solutions for the semiconductor and AI supply chains, becoming a crucial piece of Taiwan’s path to net‑zero by 2050.

Peng noted that Taiwan generates about five million tonnes of agricultural residuals each year, such as banana and pineapple plant waste, which have traditionally been burned or composted, missing their full circular‑resource potential. To reach the one‑million‑ton carbon‑removal target by 2030, the Ministry of Environment is actively collaborating with the Ministry of Agriculture to form a “Biochar Taiwan Team,” promoting sandbox trials to accelerate the development of domestic methodologies.

He added that, faced with the urgent demand from global semiconductor and AI supply chains for high‑standard carbon removal, biochar offers strong technical and economic feasibility and could become a key driver for the green transformation of Taiwan’s high‑tech industries.

Regarding regulatory alignment, the Ministry will draw on the European Carbon Removal Certification Framework (CRCF), European Biochar Certification (EBC), Japan’s agricultural biochar strategy, and the EU CRCF Buyers’ Club to build internationally compatible certification and trading mechanisms. Peng emphasized that although Taiwan is not a party to the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change, it can still pursue bilateral cooperation under Article 6.2 of the Paris Agreement. Taiwan has already signed a memorandum of understanding with Paraguay and will jointly promote biochar and forest‑carbon‑sink projects under the Paris Agreement framework, opening new opportunities for global climate action participation.

On domestic achievements and future outlook, a central‑region company has collected waste wood from the science park to produce biochar and obtained EBC certification, showcasing local private‑sector technical strength. The Environment Ministry will integrate efforts from the Agriculture Ministry and other agencies with private‑sector capacity to propose a national biochar carbon‑removal program, coordinate green financing from financial institutions, and promote extended biochar applications such as soil amendment and construction materials to expand market demand.

Peng concluded that combining biochar with agricultural circularity, carbon pricing, and green finance is a vital piece of Taiwan’s journey to net‑zero by 2050. The Environment Ministry will continue to work with other ministries, academia, and industry to ensure Taiwan plays a key role in the global carbon‑removal market.

items.title: 宏捷科9月營收年月雙增 法人估2027年H1獲利有望轉佳
items.title_en: MacroTech's September Revenue Grows Month-over-Month and Year-over-Year; Analysts Expect H1 2027 Profit to Improve
paras: 砷化鎵PA大廠宏捷科(8086-TW)今(2)日公告9月營收為4.21億元、月增0.05%、年增8.4%，第3季合併營收12.6億元、季減3%、年增13%，優於市場原先預期，今(2026)年前3季累計合併營收為37.83億元、年增32.11%。
法人指出，受惠於中國手機市場市占率提升及韓系客戶中高階手機PA轉單效應優於預期，宏捷科第3季營運展現韌性，拉貨動能成為支撐第3季營收的重要來源，隨著第4季進入傳統旺季，訂單需求維持暢旺，全年營收可期。
從宏捷科產品結構觀察，雖然手機相關產品面對2026年整體手機市場需求因記憶體等零組件漲價、缺料衝擊而降溫的負面環境，但持續受惠於中國手機PA廠打入韓國中階手機供應鏈、中國品牌手機高階機種所需PA代工地位穩固，及美國大客戶(IC設計公司)對中、韓旗艦機滲透率開始提高的衍生商機發揮。
此外，在既有PA業務外，宏捷科近年也加快營運轉型，希望降低對單一消費性電子景氣循環的依賴，自去(2024)年下半年起積極開拓光通訊及新興感測市場，包括砷化鎵太陽能產品，目前客戶已正式下單，主要鎖定無人機等特殊應用市場。
據法人報告指出，隨著Wi-Fi相關產品在下半年、看好宏捷科明(2027)年成長動能，包括router Wi-Fi PA訂單數量隨WiFi-7市佔率提高而增加；無人機PA今年上半年營收年增194.6%，客戶家數由1-2家增加至4-5家，後續營收成長性仍高。
在本業PA部分，法人預估下半年宏捷科的毛利率仍受到原材料採購價格偏高影響，待新機種相關產品陸續上市後，預估明年上半年毛利率即有機會回升，獲利展望亦得以轉佳。
paras_en: Gallium arsenide PA major MacroTech (8086-TW) announced today that September revenue was NT$421 million, up 0.05% month‑over‑month and 8.4% year‑over‑year. Consolidated Q3 revenue was NT$1.26 billion, down 3% quarter‑over‑quarter but up 13% year‑over‑year, beating market expectations. For the first three quarters of 2026, cumulative consolidated revenue reached NT$3.783 billion, a 32.11% increase year‑over‑year.

Analysts note that MacroTech benefited from a higher market share in China’s smartphone market and stronger-than‑expected PA order shifts from Korean mid‑to‑high‑end handset customers. The company’s Q3 operations showed resilience, with freight‑pulling momentum becoming a key driver of revenue. As Q4 enters the traditional peak season and order demand remains robust, full‑year revenue looks promising.

Looking at MacroTech’s product mix, although smartphone‑related items face a cooling market in 2026 due to higher component prices and material shortages, the company continues to gain from Chinese PA manufacturers entering the Korean mid‑range handset supply chain, solid PA outsourcing positions for Chinese high‑end phones, and emerging opportunities as a major U.S. IC design customer raises its penetration of Chinese and Korean flagship devices.

Beyond its core PA business, MacroTech has accelerated its operational transformation in recent years to reduce reliance on a single consumer‑electronics cycle. Since the second half of 2024, it has actively pursued optical‑communication and emerging sensor markets, including gallium‑arsenide solar products, for which customers have already placed formal orders, primarily targeting special‑application markets such as drones.

According to the analyst report, Wi‑Fi‑related products are expected to pick up in the second half of the year, and MacroTech’s growth momentum for 2027 looks favorable. Router Wi‑Fi PA order volumes are set to rise as Wi‑Fi 7 market share expands; drone PA revenue grew 194.6% year‑over‑year in the first half of this year, with the customer base expanding from 1‑2 to 4‑5 clients, indicating strong future revenue growth potential.

For its core PA segment, analysts project that MacroTech’s gross margin will remain pressured in the second half of the year due to elevated raw‑material procurement costs. However, as new‑model related products roll out, gross margins are expected to recover in the first half of next year, improving the profit outlook.

items.title: 台積電加碼美國德州？經部表態協助全球布局 但核心技術「根留台灣」
items.title_en: TSMC Expands in Texas? Ministry of Economic Affairs Says It Will Help Global Layout but Core Technology Remains Firmly in Taiwan
paras: 針對媒體報導台積電（2330-TW）（TSM-US）將布局美國德州、擴大對美投資一事，經濟部今（2）日回應表示，台灣半導體產業實力強勁，在全球占據關鍵地位。在面對全球供應鏈韌性需求增加的背景下，政府尊重企業因應國際客戶需求、爭取更大國際商機所進行的全球多元布局。同時強調，台灣依然是全球最重要的半導體生產與研發基地，關鍵前瞻技術仍會堅定根留台灣。
業界傳出，台積電繼先前於美國亞利桑那州推動建廠計畫後，傳出規劃進一步將投資足跡延伸至德州，以深化在美國當地的半導體供應鏈能量。對此，經濟部指出，台積電目前公開宣布赴美投資累積金額為2650億美元，相關具體投資計畫仍以公司向外界說明為宜，經濟部也會持續與台積電保持密切溝通與互動，全力協助企業進行海內外布局並拓展國際市場。
隨著近年全球供應鏈重組壓力增加，半導體製造戰略地位顯著提升，台美兩國在半導體產業的合作也日益緊密。經濟部表示，台美已經簽訂台美投資MOU，進一步強化雙方戰略夥伴關係並加強產業合作，政府未來將針對台灣企業赴美投資提供更強化之協助，以順應國際趨勢並鞏固產業影響力。
經濟部同時強調，企業在布局全球的同時，台灣依然是全球最重要的半導體生產與研發基地，關鍵前瞻技術仍會堅定根留台灣。政府將會盡力協助企業在台灣持續擴大投資，確保台灣在半導體供應鏈中的核心優勢地位與科技實力。
paras_en: In response to media reports that TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) will set up operations in Texas and increase its U.S. investment, the Ministry of Economic Affairs said today that Taiwan’s semiconductor industry is strong and occupies a critical global position. Amid growing demand for supply‑chain resilience, the government respects companies’ decisions to diversify globally to meet international customer needs and capture larger opportunities, while emphasizing that Taiwan remains the world’s most important semiconductor manufacturing and R&D hub and that key forward‑looking technologies will stay firmly rooted in Taiwan.

Industry sources say that after TSMC’s earlier plant project in Arizona, the company is planning to extend its investment footprint to Texas to deepen its semiconductor supply‑chain presence in the United States. The ministry noted that TSMC has publicly announced cumulative U.S. investments of $265 billion, and that specific project details should be provided by the company itself. The ministry will continue close communication with TSMC and fully support the firm’s overseas and domestic layout and market expansion.

With increasing pressure to restructure global supply chains, the strategic importance of semiconductor manufacturing has risen sharply, and Taiwan‑U.S. cooperation in the sector is becoming ever tighter. The ministry said Taiwan and the United States have signed a Taiwan‑U.S. investment MOU to further strengthen their strategic partnership and industry collaboration, and that the government will enhance assistance for Taiwanese firms investing in the U.S. to align with global trends and consolidate industry influence.

The ministry also stressed that while companies expand globally, Taiwan remains the world’s most important semiconductor manufacturing and R&D base, and that key forward‑looking technologies will stay firmly rooted in Taiwan. The government will do its utmost to help firms continue expanding investment in Taiwan, ensuring the island’s core advantage and technological strength in the semiconductor supply chain.

items.title: 北市12家企業參展新加坡科技周聚焦AI 估促成3105萬美元潛在商機
items.title_en: Taipei City’s 12 Companies Exhibit at Singapore Tech Week, Focusing on AI, Forecast to Generate $31.05 Million in Potential Business
paras: 台北市產發局近日率12家企業於「2026新加坡科技周」大放異彩，以「Smart Tech．Innovative Taipei」設置「台北主題館」，鎖定新加坡數位轉型浪潮下的市場需求，聚焦AI多元應用，展現北市企業從運算設備、資料治理到終端應用的AI軟硬整合實力，在2日展期中，預估促成逾3,105萬美元潛在商機，促進台星雙方產業交流與合作。
協辦單位外貿協會表示，本次台北主題館依技術鏈與應用需求，規劃「智慧運算與感知」、「資料治理與安全」及「智慧應用與服務」三大展示面向，呈現AI技術在企業營運、資訊安全、商務服務及人才培訓等領域的應用。
透過展前買主邀約精準瞭解市場需求，提前安排洽談對焦接觸潛在合作夥伴；現場到訪買主則由台北主題館工作人員及導覽人員依其需求，媒合引介至相關企業展台，館內並設置開放式洽談桌，提供買主與參展企業充分交流互動的空間，也安排多場媒合洽談會、貴賓導覽及媒體採訪，並邀請當地企業代表及重要公協會交流，協助建立在地商脈、掌握新加坡市場商業模式。
在展場交流方面，光影立方與海外零售通路業者就裸眼3D視覺解決方案進行洽談，並簽訂星馬地區代理合作，後續將持續拓展其他市場；輔信(2405-TW)科技亦與多家潛在客戶及合作夥伴交流，其中與新加坡AI解決方案業者就邊緣AI工業電腦、大型語言模型優化及AI Agent(AI代理人)等應用需求交換意見，後續將持續洽談合作可能性。

展會期間，參展企業亦受邀參與大會發表活動，分享創新技術與應用方案，展現AI產業鏈的國際競爭力與創新能量。皓博科技以「AI-Ready Data Pipelines – From Raw Data to Actionable Insights」為題發表，與可口可樂、Google Cloud的代表，交流如何運用AI分析資料、取得可供應用的洞察；以力、愛比科技、核桃運算及光影立方則參與「Reimagining Work with AI by Our Side」主題發表，愛比科技邀請現場觀眾體驗AI即時語音翻譯，呈現企業在資料應用與AI工作場域的不同解決方案。
產發局表示，新加坡是台北企業鏈結東南亞市場的關鍵節點，去(2025)年初次參加新加坡科技周即促成約2,500萬美元的潛在商機，今年更深耕突破，展後將持續追蹤參展企業的洽談情形與合作需求，並彙整商機開發、通路拓展及技術合作等成果，協助企業推進跨國合作機會，帶動城市經濟與產業競爭力成長。
paras_en: The Taipei City Economic Development Bureau recently led 12 companies to shine at the 2026 Singapore Tech Week, setting up a "Smart Tech·Innovative Taipei" Taipei Pavilion. Targeting market demand amid Singapore’s digital‑transformation wave, the pavilion highlighted diverse AI applications and showcased the city’s AI hardware‑software integration capabilities—from computing equipment and data governance to end‑user solutions. Over the two‑day exhibition, it is estimated to generate more than US$31.05 million in potential business, fostering industry exchange and cooperation between Taiwan and Singapore.

Co‑organiser the Taiwan External Trade Development Council said the Taipei Pavilion was organized around three major showcase themes—"Intelligent Computing and Sensing," "Data Governance and Security," and "Intelligent Applications and Services"—to demonstrate AI’s use in corporate operations, information security, business services and talent training.

By pre‑event buyer invitations, market needs were precisely identified and meetings were scheduled in advance to connect with potential partners. On‑site, pavilion staff and guides matched visiting buyers with relevant exhibitor booths based on their needs; an open‑talking area was provided for extensive interaction, and multiple matchmaking sessions, VIP tours and media interviews were arranged. Local company representatives and key industry associations were also invited to help build local networks and understand Singapore’s business models.

During the exhibition, LightCube and an overseas retail channel operator discussed a naked‑eye 3D visual solution and signed an agency agreement for the Singapore‑Malaysia region, with plans to expand to other markets. Fu‑Xin Technology (2405‑TW) also engaged with several prospective customers and partners, exchanging views with a Singapore AI solutions provider on edge‑AI industrial PCs, large‑language‑model optimization and AI agents, and will continue to explore cooperation possibilities.

Throughout the show, participating companies were invited to present at conference sessions, sharing innovative technologies and solutions that highlight the international competitiveness and creative energy of the AI value chain. HaoBo Technology presented “AI‑Ready Data Pipelines – From Raw Data to Actionable Insights,” discussing with representatives from Coca‑Cola and Google Cloud how to use AI for data analysis and actionable insights. Li‑Force, Aibi Technology, Walnut Computing and LightCube took part in the “Reimagining Work with AI by Our Side” session, with Aibi Technology offering live AI‑powered speech translation to showcase varied solutions for data use and AI‑enabled workplaces.

The Economic Development Bureau noted that Singapore is a key gateway for Taipei firms to reach Southeast Asian markets. The city’s first participation in Singapore Tech Week in early 2025 generated roughly US$25 million in potential business; this year’s deeper engagement is expected to yield even more. After the exhibition, the bureau will continue to monitor negotiations and cooperation needs, compile outcomes in business development, channel expansion and technology collaboration, and help firms advance cross‑border opportunities, driving growth in the city’s economy and industrial competitiveness.

items.title: 惠民旗下惠嘉水務奪「嘉義縣擴大縣治再生水廠BTO案」投資16.9億元
items.title_en: Huimin's subsidiary Huijia Water Wins "Chiayi County Expanded County Seat Recycled Water Plant BTO Project" with a NT$1.69 billion investment
paras: 環工、水務廠商惠民實業 (6971-TW) 旗下子公司惠嘉水務今 (2) 日公布拿下「嘉義縣擴大縣治再生水廠BTO案」，將採取(Build-Transfer-Operate，BTO)的興建-移轉-營運模式，預計投資金額16.9億元。
環工廠商惠民實業旗下子公司惠嘉水務拿下的此一再生水務BTO工程案，預計興建期為1195日曆天，營運期自營運開始日起算15年。
惠民指出，惠嘉應依投資契約約定期限完成相關設施的興建及營運，並提供興建期及營運期履約保證金，履行相關營運管理、水質標準、設備維護及資產轉移等義務。
惠民目前股本約 3.87 億元，惠民實業主要業務為水資源及廢棄物處理，水資源包含公共污水處理廠、再生水、海水淡化及淨水場，也包含近期受社會關注的水利工程，如抽水站、滯洪池等，這些水資源處理惠民實業提供操作維護以及興建、更新及工程承攬等服務。
而日前欣陸投控(3703-TW)旗下欣達環工也宣布，正式獲評為「新竹市客雅水資源回收中心放流水回收再利用BTO案」最優申請人，並已完成議約程序。本案預估投資金額約84.5億元，興建及特許期合計約18年6個月，建置再生水系統後，每日供應寶山二期園區4萬噸再生水。
欣陸投控指出，「新竹市客雅水資源回收中心放流水回收再利用BTO案」，採BTO，興建、移轉及營運）模式推動，主要包括客雅水資源回收中心污水處理廠擴建工程、再生水廠新建工程，以及相關取輸水與輸配水設施。完工後污水處理廠整體處理能力達70,000 CMD；再生水系統每日可供應4萬噸再生水，主要供應寶山二期園區使用。
paras_en: Environmental engineering and water services company Huimin Industrial (6971‑TW) announced today that its subsidiary Huijia Water has secured the "Chiayi County Expanded County Seat Recycled Water Plant BTO Project," which will use a Build‑Transfer‑Operate (BTO) model and is expected to involve an investment of NT$1.69 billion.

The recycled‑water BTO project won by Huijia Water, a subsidiary of Huimin Industrial, is slated for a construction period of 1,195 calendar days, followed by a 15‑year operating term counted from the start of operations.

Huimin stated that Huijia must complete the construction and operation of the related facilities within the contractually agreed timeframe, provide performance guarantees for both the construction and operation phases, and fulfill obligations related to operational management, water‑quality standards, equipment maintenance, and asset transfer.

Huimin currently has a share capital of about NT$387 million. Its core business covers water resources and waste‑treatment services, including public sewage treatment plants, reclaimed water, seawater desalination, and drinking‑water facilities, as well as water‑infrastructure projects that have recently drawn public attention such as pumping stations and detention ponds. Huimin provides operation‑maintenance, construction, upgrade and engineering contracting services for these water‑resource projects.

Earlier, Xinlu Investment Holding (3703‑TW) subsidiary XinDa Environmental Engineering announced that it had been formally selected as the top applicant for the "Hsinchu City Ke‑Ya Water‑Resource Recovery Center Effluent Recycling and Reuse BTO Project" and has completed the contract‑signing process. The project is estimated to require an investment of about NT$8.45 billion, with a combined construction and concession period of roughly 18 years and 6 months, and will supply 40,000 tons of reclaimed water per day to the Baoshan Phase‑II industrial park after the system is built.

Xinlu Investment Holding explained that the "Hsinchu City Ke‑Ya Water‑Resource Recovery Center Effluent Recycling and Reuse BTO Project" follows a BTO (build, transfer, operate) approach, encompassing the expansion of the Ke‑Ya water‑resource recovery center sewage‑treatment plant, the construction of a new reclaimed‑water plant, and related water‑intake, transmission and distribution facilities. Upon completion, the sewage‑treatment plant will have a total capacity of 70,000 cubic meters per day, and the reclaimed‑water system will be able to supply 40,000 tons of reclaimed water daily, primarily for the Baoshan Phase‑II park.

items.title: 鴻海攜手祥寶參展台北國際照顧博覽會 智慧長照三大場域啟動實證
items.title_en: Foxconn Partners with Xiangbao to Exhibit at Taipei International Care Expo, Launching Three Smart Long-Term Care Pilot Sites
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)與祥寶尊榮長照集團於Cares Expo Taipei 2026台北國際照顧博覽會展出智慧長照合作成果，雙方於桃園寶之林、太原祥寶及怡德日照中心三大場域進行實證，驗證AI與健康數據融入日常照護流程的可行性。
雙方自2025年11月起推動智慧長照合作，導入智慧穿戴、AI運算、端雲整合及人機協作等技術，並合作重點並非單純導入智慧設備，而是從實際照護流程出發，觀察長者、照護人員及系統平台的使用需求，檢視健康數據與照護流程的串聯方式，並將場域累積的經驗作為後續產品及服務優化依據，逐步建立以數據、AI及人機協作為基礎的智慧長照模式。
在長者端，智慧穿戴讓健康管理從照護人員監測，逐步增加長者自主參與；在照護端，則透過個人化監測、異常資訊上報及數據整合，協助照護人員掌握長者狀況，讓AI支援照護工作，建立「Human + AI」人機協作模式。
此次展會現場也展示雙方智慧照護成果，包括CoDoctor Pro、CoDoctor Home、CoDoctor Watch及Nurabot護理協作機器人等，涵蓋智慧穿戴、軟硬體整合及端雲平台應用，從單一產品逐步走向整合型智慧長照解決方案。
祥寶尊榮長照集團今年適逢深耕長照40週年，並於展覽首日舉行40週年慶典暨開幕儀式，祥寶董事長林哲弘表示，真正的AI-Native Long Care並不是把AI放進長照，而是重新思考長照如何運作。未來祥寶將持續與鴻海深化合作，在更多長照場域累積實證經驗，推動智慧科技由單一產品走向平台解決方案，朝智慧醫養及AI原生長照發展。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317-TW) and Xiangbao Premium Long-Term Care Group showcased their smart long‑term care collaboration at Cares Expo Taipei 2026, demonstrating results from three pilot sites—Taoyuan Baozhilin, Taiyuan Xiangbao, and Yide Daycare Center—where they validated the feasibility of integrating AI and health data into everyday care processes.

Since November 2025, the two parties have been advancing a smart long‑term care partnership that introduces smart wearables, AI computing, edge‑cloud integration and human‑machine collaboration. The focus is not merely on deploying smart devices but on starting from actual care workflows, observing the needs of seniors, caregivers and the platform, examining how health data links with care processes, and using the accumulated field experience to refine future products and services, gradually building a data‑, AI‑ and human‑machine‑collaboration‑based smart care model.

For seniors, smart wearables shift health management from caregiver monitoring toward greater self‑participation; for caregivers, personalized monitoring, abnormal alerts and data integration help them keep track of seniors’ conditions, allowing AI to support caregiving and establishing a “Human + AI” collaboration model.

The expo also displayed the partners’ smart care achievements, including CoDoctor Pro, CoDoctor Home, CoDoctor Watch and the Nurabot nursing collaboration robot, covering smart wearables, hardware‑software integration and edge‑cloud platform applications, moving from single products toward integrated smart long‑term care solutions.

This year marks Xiangbao Premium Long‑Term Care Group’s 40th anniversary of deep involvement in long‑term care. On the opening day of the exhibition, a 40‑year celebration and ceremony were held. Chairman Lin Zhe‑hong said that true AI‑Native Long Care is not about merely inserting AI into care, but rethinking how care operates. Xiangbao will continue to deepen cooperation with Foxconn, gather more field evidence across additional care sites, and advance smart technology from isolated products to platform solutions, driving development toward smart medical‑nursing and AI‑native long‑term care.

items.title: 聚陽Q3營收創近6季最佳 累計營收重返正成長 Q4可望維持年增
items.title_en: Juyang Q3 Revenue Hits Best in Nearly Six Quarters, Cumulative Revenue Returns to Positive Growth; Q4 Expected to Maintain Year-over-Year Increase
paras: 成衣代工大廠聚陽(1477-TW)今(2)日公告9月營收29.3億元，月減17.5%、年增24%；第三季營收94.84億元，創近6季最佳，季增16.1%、年增6.7%；累計前9月營收265.46億元，年增0.2%，重返成長軌道。
聚陽表示，第三季營收表現符合公司預期，回到個位數年增；展望第四季，雖然戰爭未解、高油價及通膨等外部不確定因素仍在，但目前訂單能見度仍達年底，預計第四季業績可望維持年增表現，全年維持較去年成長的目標。
聚陽進一步指出，目前運動盤需求穩健，除了產品單價較高、毛利率較佳，客戶也陸續下急單，並進一步推升價格；隨著第四季至明年第一季進入運動盤傳統旺季，可望帶動營收表現。目前運動盤營收比重約5成，旺季可能提升至6成。
展望明年，聚陽持相對正向看法，主要是美國期中選舉落幕、戰爭因素也可望淡化，隨著負面因素影響逐漸消退，有助提振市場信心；另一方面，AI快速崛起，具備快速反應及彈性的供應商也較具優勢，這也是聚陽的強項。
paras_en: Garment OEM giant Juyang (1477-TW) announced today (2) September revenue of NT$2.93 billion, down 17.5% month‑on‑month, up 24% year‑on‑year; third‑quarter revenue of NT$9.484 billion, the best in almost six quarters, up 16.1% sequentially and 6.7% year‑on‑year; cumulative revenue for the first nine months of NT$26.546 billion, up 0.2% year‑on‑year, returning to growth.

Juyang said the Q3 revenue performance met company expectations, returning to single‑digit year‑over‑year growth; looking ahead to Q4, although external uncertainties such as the unresolved war, high oil prices and inflation remain, order visibility still extends to year‑end, and the company expects Q4 results to maintain year‑over‑year growth, keeping the full‑year growth target over last year.

Juyang further noted that demand for sports plates remains solid; besides higher product prices and better gross margins, customers are also placing urgent orders and further pushing up prices; with Q4 through Q1 of next year entering the traditional peak season for sports plates, revenue performance is expected to be boosted. Currently, sports‑plate revenue accounts for about 50% of total, which could rise to 60% in the peak season.

Looking to next year, Juyang remains relatively optimistic, mainly because the U.S. midterm elections have concluded and war‑related factors are expected to ease; as negative influences gradually recede, market confidence should improve. Moreover, the rapid rise of AI gives an edge to suppliers that can respond quickly and flexibly, which is a strength of Juyang.

items.title: 輝達盤中再創高！市值衝5.7兆美元 史上首家6兆美元企業近了？
items.title_en: NVIDIA Hits New Intraday High! Market Cap Rises to $5.7 Trillion, Within $300 Billion of Becoming the First $6 Trillion Company?
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)股價周五盤中(2日)一度上漲2.9%，首度突破今年5月以來的紀錄，市值升至約5.7兆美元，距離成為史上首家市值達6兆美元的企業，已不到3,000億美元。投資人重新湧入這家全球市值最高的上市公司，帶動股價自7月底低點反彈近25%。
截稿前，輝達盤中股價上漲2.09%，每股暫報235.68美元；市值暫報5.68兆美元。
據《彭博》報導，輝達先前因市場擔憂人工智慧(AI)前景，歷經兩個月賣壓，市值一度蒸發逾1兆美元。近期隨著AI代理應用帶動晶片需求的期待升高，加上公司擴大股票回購，股價重拾漲勢。
Meta(META-US)旗下Muse等AI代理服務，被市場視為可能推升半導體需求的新動力。輝達周一另宣布，將股票回購計畫增加1,500億美元，新增規模創公司紀錄，進一步提振投資人信心。
不過，輝達這波反彈也反映AI產業情緒快速變化。過去幾個月，市場持續質疑企業投入數千億美元建置AI基礎設施的效益，也愈來愈關注先進AI可能對人類帶來的安全風險。
為回應相關疑慮，輝達周一推出新的雙層AI安全系統，目標是防止AI代理失控。公司表示，這套系統原本可以阻止近期OpenAI模型入侵開源平台Hugging Face的事件。在投資人更加重視AI安全之際，這項措施也成為輝達近期布局的一環。
輝達今年以來股價累計上漲約27%，有望連續第四年繳出雙位數報酬。隨著市值逼近6兆美元，AI代理能否持續帶動晶片需求，以及企業龐大AI投資的前景，仍牽動市場對其成長潛力的評估。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) shares rose as much as 2.9% during Friday’s session (the 2nd), breaking the record set in May this year for the first time; its market value climbed to roughly $5.7 trillion, now less than $300 billion away from becoming the first company ever to reach a $6 trillion valuation. Investors poured back into the world’s most valuable listed firm, lifting the stock about 25% from its late‑July low.
At the time of writing, NVIDIA’s intraday price was up 2.09%, reporting a provisional $235.68 per share and a market cap of about $5.68 trillion.

According to Bloomberg, NVIDIA had previously faced market worries about the outlook for artificial intelligence (AI), enduring two months of selling pressure that erased more than $1 trillion in market value. Recently, rising expectations for chip demand driven by AI‑agent applications and an expanded share‑repurchase program have helped the stock regain its upward momentum.

Meta’s (META-US) AI‑agent services such as Muse are seen by the market as a potential new driver of semiconductor demand. On Monday, NVIDIA also announced an additional $150 billion to its share‑repurchase plan, the largest increase in the company’s history, further bolstering investor confidence.

However, this rally also reflects the rapid shifts in sentiment toward the AI industry. In recent months, the market has continued to question the value of companies spending tens of billions of dollars to build AI infrastructure and has grown increasingly concerned about the safety risks that advanced AI could pose to humanity.

In response to those concerns, NVIDIA launched a new two‑layer AI safety system on Monday aimed at preventing AI agents from going out of control. The company said the system could have blocked the recent incident in which an OpenAI model attempted to infiltrate the open‑source platform Hugging Face. As investors place greater emphasis on AI safety, the measure has become part of NVIDIA’s recent strategic rollout.

Since the start of the year, NVIDIA’s stock has risen about 27%, positioning it for a fourth consecutive year of double‑digit returns. With market value edging toward $6 trillion, whether AI agents can sustain chip demand and the outlook for massive corporate AI spending will continue to shape market assessments of the company’s growth potential.

items.title: 油輪重返荷姆茲難救通膨！布蘭特油價破百 煉油瓶頸加劇美債拋售潮
items.title_en: Oil Tankers Return to the Hormuz Strait Fails to Ease Inflation! Brent Crude Breaks $100, Refining Bottlenecks Intensify US Treasury Sell‑off
paras: 油輪重返荷姆茲海峽，原本應該有助於壓低原油、汽油與柴油價格，進而抑制通膨並降低全球借貸成本，但目前情況並非如此：供應鏈將原油轉化為燃料的環節仍遭受衝擊，持續推高能源價格，助長美債賣壓。
在美軍削弱伊朗對荷姆茲海峽控制的情況下，石油運輸量逐漸回升至接近戰前水準，但作為全球原油期貨基準的布蘭特原油周四(1日)仍大漲4.4%至每桶102.31美元。由美國汽車協會(AAA)追蹤的美國汽油平均價格仍維持在每加侖4.41美元以上。10年期美債殖利率本周則升至24年來最高水準。
華爾街日報(WSJ)報導，導致債券殖利率居高不下的因素，來自多項彼此交織的威脅，而這些因素正持續擠壓石油市場：

荷姆茲海峽的船舶通行量預估分歧很大，交易員擔心局勢再度升溫，隨時可能讓供應量大幅下降。
葉門胡塞武裝(Houthi)持續威脅阿拉伯半島周邊同樣運輸石油的航線。
距離中東數千英里之外，烏克蘭持續發動空襲，鎖定俄羅斯煉油廠，而俄羅斯煉油廠過去一直是供應柴油給許多工業經濟體的重要來源。


這些因素推高了原油運輸與燃料加工成本，進而提高汽車、卡車、商用飛機及農業設備等各類交通與生產工具的營運成本。

荷姆茲運輸恢復 成品油供應仍吃緊

這項瓶頸正讓美國通膨受到後續衝擊，影響可能持續到11月期中選舉之後，並迫使聯準會(Fed)考慮未來數月進一步升息。與此同時，債券市場早就難以消化人工智慧(AI)相關債務大量湧現、龐大的財政赤字，以及足以讓通膨持續超標的強勁經濟。
10年期美債殖利率周四雖然稍稍回落至5.233%，但在周三為止的一季創下1994年以來最大單季升幅，並推動美國房貸利率突破7%。
瑞銀投資銀行(UBS Investment Bank)全球經濟與策略主管Arend Kapteyn說：「目前市場對美國與伊朗是否朝某種正式協議取得進展，以及局勢是否可能進一步中斷供應，仍高度敏感。從央行的角度來看，不能只關注原油，還要關注(煉製)成品油，而成品油市場非常吃緊。」

庫存緩衝大減

目前美國海軍逐漸削弱伊朗攻擊油輪或附近能源設施的能力，在戰爭開打八個月後，波斯灣產油國與航運公司也愈來愈擅長抵禦或躲避攻擊。摩根士丹利(Morgan Stanley)分析師預估，中東原油出口量近期如今僅比戰前水準低7%。
但考量到許多油輪關閉追蹤系統，或在船與船之間轉移貨物以降低遭到攻擊的風險，其他分析師對航運恢復程度仍抱持審慎態度。
伊朗在葉門的代理人胡塞武裝再次攻擊區域航線，也促使交易員在持有部位納入更高的風險溢價，進而支撐能源價格。
伊朗戰爭爆發至今，市場一直靠從中國、歐洲到美國的庫存提供緩衝，但如今庫存已大幅下降，需要重新補充，而且幾乎沒有犯錯的空間。這種不確定性讓交易員緊盯美國與中國可能限制燃料出口的消息。

中東成品油出口比戰前低40%

儘管原油期貨價格已從近期高點回落，但實體原油貨物的價格仍維持高檔，顯示煉油商爭相鎖定短期供應。用來追蹤即期交割的基準價格、北海現貨原油價格是周四報每桶127.42美元。
CIBC Private Wealth資深能源交易員Rebecca Babin說：「無論數據顯示有多少原油正經過荷姆茲海峽，市場的需求顯然仍存在。」
摩根大通(JP Morgan)預估，中東汽油、柴油與航空燃油等成品油出口量，目前仍比戰前水準低約40%。

原油進入市場成本大增

還要考慮一點：油輪運輸量雖然回升，但原油進入市場的成本也大幅飆升。從波斯灣向西航行的油輪，有時必須繞行非洲南端，以避開胡塞武裝的攻擊威脅。此外，許多航運公司會將石油從波斯灣運往荷姆茲海峽外圍，再在當地轉運給前往其他目的地的船隻。
這些因素占用了全球大量超大型油輪運力，並推高運費。根據Argus數據，從中東運送原油至中國的超大型油輪，近期一趟約21天的航程，成本相當於每桶35美元，而戰爭爆發前一天的成本還不到每桶7美元。

中東煉油產能下降 柴油與原油價差創紀錄

當原油抵達煉油廠後，成本壓力又進一步擴大。由於中東煉油產能下降，加上烏克蘭攻擊俄羅斯煉油廠，促使莫斯科限制柴油出口，交易員願意向其他仍有能力大量生產燃料的企業支付溢價。
在紐約，柴油期貨近期價格約為原油價格的兩倍，柴油與原油之間的價差遠超過過去任何紀錄，推升加油站的批發成本。
許多能源業高層預料這種情況將持續。達拉斯聯準銀行本周公布的調查顯示，48%的受訪者認為，柴油價格與原油成本之間的價差至少需要一年才會恢復至2025年水準，約36%的受訪者對汽油價差也持相同看法。

殖利率仍可能走高

美國企業在年初或戰爭爆發後初期鎖定的部分避險成本，如今即將到期，讓農民、居家修繕商店及卡車業者等企業正面臨艱難抉擇。
U.S. Bank商品團隊主管Charlie Macnamara指出，目前較高的價格「將開始滲透到這些企業的避險計畫中，最終也會傳導至終端消費者」。
儘管能源價格仍處於令人難以承受的高檔，分析師認為，能源價格目前還沒有高到足以迫使經濟大幅放緩的程度，尤其美國經濟仍受到人工智慧(AI)熱潮與創歷史新高的股市支撐。
Principal Asset Management首席全球策略師Seema Shah說：「如果經濟韌性與投資需求持續，殖利率可能仍有進一步走高的空間。」
paras_en: Oil tankers have returned to the Hormuz Strait, which should have helped lower crude, gasoline and diesel prices and thus curb inflation and reduce global borrowing costs, but that is not the case: the supply‑chain link that turns crude into fuel is still under pressure, keeping energy prices high and feeding the sell‑off in US Treasuries.

With US forces weakening Iran’s control of the Hormuz Strait, oil shipments are gradually climbing back toward pre‑war levels, yet Brent crude – the global benchmark – jumped 4.4% on Thursday the 1st to $102.31 a barrel. The average US gasoline price tracked by the American Automobile Association (AAA) remains above $4.41 per gallon, and 10‑year US Treasury yields this week rose to their highest level in 24 years.
The Wall Street Journal reported that the forces keeping bond yields elevated stem from a web of inter‑linked threats that are also squeezing the oil market.

Estimates of ship traffic through the Hormuz Strait vary widely, and traders fear a resurgence of tension could sharply cut supplies. Houthi rebels in Yemen continue to threaten oil‑carrying routes around the Arabian Peninsula. Thousands of miles away, Ukraine keeps launching air strikes on Russian refineries, which have long been a key diesel source for many industrial economies.

The bottleneck is feeding back into US inflation and could affect the market through the November mid‑term elections, forcing the Federal Reserve to consider further rate hikes in the coming months. At the same time, the bond market has long struggled to absorb a flood of AI‑related debt, massive fiscal deficits and a robust economy that keeps inflation above target.
Although 10‑year Treasury yields slipped slightly to 5.233% on Thursday, they had set the biggest quarterly gain since 1994 by Wednesday and pushed US mortgage rates past 7%.

Arend Kapteyn, global economics and strategy head at UBS Investment Bank, said: “The market remains highly sensitive to any progress toward a formal agreement between the US and Iran or to any further supply disruptions. From a central‑bank perspective you can’t just watch crude; you have to watch refined products, and the refined‑product market is extremely tight.”

Inventory buffers have shrunk dramatically. The US Navy is gradually reducing Iran’s ability to attack tankers or nearby energy facilities, and eight months into the war, Persian Gulf producers and shipping firms have become more adept at evading or defending against attacks. Morgan Stanley analysts estimate that Middle‑East crude exports are now only about 7% below pre‑war levels.
However, because many tankers have disabled tracking systems or are transshipping cargo between vessels to lower attack risk, other analysts remain cautious about how fully shipping has recovered.
Iran’s Houthi proxies in Yemen have again struck regional routes, prompting traders to price a higher risk premium into their positions and thereby supporting energy prices.

Since the war began, markets have relied on inventories from China, Europe and the US for buffering, but those stocks have now fallen sharply, need replenishment and leave almost no margin for error. This uncertainty has traders watching closely for any news that the US or China might restrict fuel exports.

Middle‑East refined‑product exports are about 40% lower than before the war. Although crude futures have retreated from recent peaks, spot physical crude prices remain high, showing refiners scrambling for short‑term supply. The benchmark spot price for North Sea crude was $127.42 a barrel on Thursday.
Rebecca Babin, a senior energy trader at CIBC Private Wealth, said: “No matter how much crude the data show moving through the Hormuz Strait, demand in the market is clearly still there.”
JP Morgan estimates that Middle‑East exports of gasoline, diesel and jet fuel are still roughly 40% below pre‑war levels.

The cost of getting crude into the market has surged. Even though tanker volumes are rising, ships sailing west from the Persian Gulf sometimes have to detour around the southern tip of Africa to avoid Houthi attacks. Many carriers also move oil from the Gulf to the outer Hormuz area before transshipping to vessels bound for other destinations.

These practices tie up a large share of the world’s ultra‑large crude tanker capacity and lift freight rates. Argus data show that a recent 21‑day voyage from the Middle East to China now costs about $35 per barrel, versus less than $7 per barrel the day before the war started.

Middle‑East refining capacity has fallen, widening the diesel‑to‑crude spread to record levels. With reduced refining in the region and Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries prompting Moscow to curb diesel exports, traders are willing to pay premiums to firms that can still produce fuel in large volumes.
In New York, diesel futures are currently trading at roughly twice the price of crude, a spread that far exceeds any historical record and pushes up wholesale costs for gas stations.

Many energy executives expect this situation to persist. A Dallas Fed survey this week found that 48% of respondents think the diesel‑crude spread will not return to 2025 levels for at least a year, and about 36% hold the same view for the gasoline spread.

Yield pressures may keep rising. Hedging costs that US companies locked in early in the year or shortly after the war began are now expiring, leaving farmers, home‑improvement retailers and trucking firms facing tough choices.
Charlie Macnamara, head of the commodities team at U.S. Bank, said higher prices “will start to seep into these companies’ hedging programs and ultimately be passed on to end consumers.”

Even though energy prices remain painfully high, analysts say they are not yet high enough to force a sharp economic slowdown, especially as the US economy is still buoyed by the AI boom and record‑high equity markets.
Seema Shah, chief global strategist at Principal Asset Management, warned: “If economic resilience and investment demand persist, yields could still have room to move higher.”

items.title: 連兩年下滑後有轉機？特斯拉Q3交車勝預期 分析師看好全年銷量
items.title_en: Is There a Turnaround After Two Years of Decline? Tesla Q3 Deliveries Beat Expectations, Analysts Optimistic About Full-Year Sales
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)周五(2日)公布，第三季全球交車量達48萬6,532輛，優於華爾街預期，顯示核心汽車業務在連續兩年銷量下滑後，開始出現回穩跡象。歐洲需求復甦，抵銷美國購車稅務優惠取消及中國競爭加劇的部分壓力，帶動股價早盤上漲。
綜合外媒報導，特斯拉交車量高於《彭博》彙整的46萬3,761輛平均預估，也超過Visible Alpha調查的45萬6,896輛。截至紐約時間上午9時34分，股價上漲4%；不過，截至前一交易日，今年累計仍下跌逾21%。
截稿前，特斯拉(TSLA-US)周五盤中股價上漲5.44%，每股暫報373.37美元。

交車優於預期 全年有望終結連兩年下滑

第三季交車量仍低於去年同期的49萬7,099輛，年減約2.1%。去年同期因美國消費者趕在聯邦購車優惠取消前購車，創下季度交車紀錄，墊高比較基期。
今年第三季Model 3與Model Y合計交付47萬8,237輛，其餘車款僅8,295輛，顯示兩款主力車仍占絕大多數銷量。同期產量為46萬4,391輛，低於市場預估的48萬6,761輛。
特斯拉第四季至少需交付31萬1,448輛，才能避免全年交車量連續第三年下滑。分析師已將2026年全年預估由6月的165萬輛上修至182萬輛，反映需求前景改善。
歐洲是主要支撐。特斯拉去年因馬斯克政治立場引發反彈而銷售受挫，今年前八個月歐盟新車掛牌量則成長66%，8月成長約53%。Model Y更成為法國單月最暢銷車款，首次有特斯拉車型登上該榜首。
上海廠7、8月出口量也接近翻倍，協助抵銷中國市場競爭壓力。分析師預期，已獲歐洲八國批准的全自動輔助駕駛(FSD)軟體，隨部署推進可望進一步支持銷售。

AI布局仍牽動估值 汽車業務提供營收支撐

儘管馬斯克持續將投資人焦點轉向AI、自動駕駛與Optimus人形機器人，汽車仍是特斯拉最大的營收來源。公司約1.4兆美元估值高度仰賴長期願景，季度交車仍是檢視核心業務的重要指標。
特斯拉在德州與佛州的自駕計程車服務，已不再配置車內安全監督員，上月也將專用車款Cybercab加入奧斯汀營運。不過，服務規模仍小於Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Waymo。
公司今年計劃支出逾250億美元，擴建工廠並發展自駕計程車業務，本周文件另揭露，已取得300億美元新貸款與信用額度。
能源業務方面，第三季儲能部署量達13.7GWh，高於去年同期的12.5GWh及第二季的13.5GWh。汽車與儲能表現改善，但龐大投資能否轉化為持續成長，仍是後續觀察重點。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) announced on Friday the 2nd that its global deliveries for the third quarter reached 486,532 vehicles, surpassing Wall Street forecasts and indicating that the core automotive business is showing signs of stabilizing after two consecutive years of sales declines. A recovery in European demand offset some pressure from the removal of U.S. purchase tax incentives and heightened competition in China, lifting the stock in early trading.

According to foreign media reports, Tesla's deliveries exceeded Bloomberg's consensus estimate of 463,761 vehicles and also beat Visible Alpha's forecast of 456,896 units. By 9:34 a.m. New York time, the share price was up 4%, though it remains down more than 21% for the year as of the previous trading day.
Just before the deadline, Tesla (TSLA-US) saw its intraday price rise 5.44% on Friday, briefly trading at $373.37 per share.

Deliveries beat expectations, raising hopes that the full year could finally end the two‑year decline. Third‑quarter deliveries were still below last year’s 497,099, a year‑over‑year drop of about 2.1%. Last year’s figure was boosted by U.S. consumers rushing to buy before the federal purchase incentive expired, setting a record quarterly delivery that raised the comparison base.

In the third quarter, Model 3 and Model Y together accounted for 478,237 deliveries, with the remaining models totaling only 8,295 units, showing that the two flagship models still dominate sales. Production for the period was 464,391, below the market estimate of 486,761.

Tesla will need to deliver at least 311,448 vehicles in the fourth quarter to avoid a third consecutive year of overall delivery declines. Analysts have raised their 2026 full‑year estimate from 1.65 million units in June to 1.82 million, reflecting an improving demand outlook.

Europe is the main support. After a sales dip last year due to backlash over Elon Musk’s political stance, new‑car registrations in the EU grew 66% in the first eight months of this year, with August alone up about 53%. The Model Y even became France’s best‑selling car for a month, the first time a Tesla model has topped the chart there.

Exports from the Shanghai plant in July and August nearly doubled, helping to offset competitive pressure in the Chinese market. Analysts expect that the fully autonomous driving (FSD) software, already approved in eight European countries, will further boost sales as deployment progresses.

AI initiatives still drive valuation, but the automotive business provides revenue support. Although Musk continues to shift investor focus toward AI, autonomous driving and the Optimus humanoid robot, cars remain Tesla’s biggest revenue source. The company’s roughly $1.4 trillion valuation heavily relies on its long‑term vision, and quarterly deliveries remain a key gauge of core business health.

Tesla’s autonomous‑taxi services in Texas and Florida no longer staff safety monitors inside the vehicles, and last month added the dedicated Cybercab model to its Austin fleet. However, the service scale remains smaller than Alphabet’s (GOOGL-US) Waymo.

The company plans to spend over $25 billion this year expanding factories and developing autonomous‑taxi operations, and documents released this week revealed it has secured a new $30 billion loan and credit facility.
