In its energy segment, third‑quarter energy storage deployments reached 13.7 GWh, higher than 12.5 GWh in the same quarter last year and 13.5 GWh in the second quarter. While automotive and storage performance have improved, whether the massive investments can translate into sustained growth remains a key focus for the future.

items.title: 美股開盤走高，那斯達克創新高就業降溫壓低升息預期
items.title_en: US Stocks Open Higher, Nasdaq Hits Record High as Cooling Jobs Damp Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 2026年10月02日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國9月就業數據低於預期，市場降低聯準會(Fed)近期再度升息的預期，美債殖利率回落，美股週五開盤走高，那斯達克指數再創歷史新高。
截至美東時間上午10時14分，道瓊工業指數上漲0.60%，標普500指數上漲1.02%，那斯達克指數上漲1.66%。科技與半導體股領漲，費城半導體指數上漲3.1%，輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)漲2.5%並觸及盤中歷史新高，Tesla(TSLA-US)漲4.1%，Oracle(ORCL-US)漲3%。
美國勞工部公布，9月非農就業僅增加2.9萬人，低於市場預估的9萬人，前兩個月數據也遭大幅下修。數據公布後，市場預估Fed 10月升息1碼的機率由26%降至20%，2年期美債殖利率連續第二天下滑。
油價同步走低，布蘭特原油跌破每桶100美元，VIX恐慌指數降至一週低點。個股方面，Nike(NKE-US)因中國市場需求疲弱並預告全年營收將大幅下滑，股價重挫5.6%。

paras_en: October 2, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – September US employment data came in below expectations, prompting the market to lower expectations for another near‑term Fed rate hike. Treasury yields fell and US equities opened higher on Friday, with the Nasdaq posting another all‑time high.

As of 10:14 a.m. Eastern Time, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was up 0.60%, the S&P 500 rose 1.02%, and the Nasdaq climbed 1.66%. Technology and semiconductor stocks led the gains, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index up 3.1%; NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) jumped 2.5% and hit an intraday record high, Tesla (TSLA‑US) rose 4.1%, and Oracle (ORCL‑US) gained 3%.

The US Labor Department reported that non‑farm payrolls added only 29,000 jobs in September, well below the market forecast of 90,000, and the figures for the prior two months were also sharply revised downward. After the release, the probability of a Fed rate hike in October fell from 26% to 20%, and the two‑year Treasury yield slipped for the second consecutive day.

Oil prices fell in tandem, with Brent crude slipping below $100 a barrel, and the VIX fear gauge dropped to a one‑week low. On the equity side, Nike (NKE‑US) saw its shares plunge 5.6% after warning of weak demand in China and a significant decline in full‑year revenue.

items.title: Nike改革兩年仍未止血！中國、Jordan兩大問題拖累，股價跌至12年低點
items.title_en: Nike's Two-Year Reform Still Fails to Stem Bleeding; China and Jordan Issues Drag Down Stock to 12-Year Low
paras: 2026年10月02日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Nike(NKE-US)執行長Elliott Hill回鍋近兩年，公司轉型仍未見明顯成效。Nike最新宣布新一輪裁員，並預估截至2028年5月止年度的營收與獲利降幅將高於市場預期，拖累股價週五早盤下跌約8%，來到約12年低點。
Nike目前主要問題集中在運動休閒產品、中國市場與Jordan品牌，三項業務合計占公司營收超過一半。Hill坦言，中國市場要恢復穩定仍需要數個季度，短期也將持續影響獲利。
Jordan同樣面臨產品供給過多問題。Nike過去大量推出復刻鞋款，造成折扣增加並削弱品牌稀缺性，目前正降低復刻鞋推出數量與頻率，希望重新提高產品定位與獲利能力。
Hill自2024年10月回鍋後，已重新加強與批發零售商合作、將產品開發重新聚焦運動市場並精簡組織，但目前批發與直營通路營收仍持續下滑。更大的問題是，這波重整帶來的大部分成本節省，要到2029及2030會計年度才會反映。
市場接下來將關注Nike預定11月16日至17日舉行的投資人日，公司預計進一步說明恢復營收成長與獲利能力的策略。

paras_en: October 2, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Nike (NKE-US) CEO Elliott Hill, who returned to the helm nearly two years ago, has yet to see clear results from the company’s transformation. Nike announced another round of layoffs and now expects revenue and profit declines through the fiscal year ending May 2028 to be deeper than market forecasts, pulling the share price down about 8% in early Friday trading to a roughly 12‑year low.

Nike’s current challenges are centered on its athleisure products, the China market, and the Jordan brand, which together account for more than half of the company’s revenue. Hill admitted that restoring stability in China will take several quarters and will continue to weigh on earnings in the short term.

Jordan is also grappling with oversupply. Nike’s past strategy of flooding the market with retro releases led to higher discounting and eroded the brand’s scarcity; the company is now cutting back the number and frequency of retro drops to re‑elevate product positioning and profitability.

Since Hill’s return in October 2024, he has re‑strengthened partnerships with wholesale retailers, refocused product development on the sports segment, and streamlined the organization, yet wholesale and direct‑to‑consumer sales continue to decline. A bigger issue is that most of the cost savings from this restructuring won’t show up in the 2029 and 2030 fiscal years.
The market will now focus on Nike’s investor day scheduled for November 16‑17, where the company plans to detail further strategies to revive revenue growth and profit margins.

items.title: Tesla第三季交車超預期！歐洲需求回溫，全年交車有望終結連兩年衰退
items.title_en: Tesla Q3 Deliveries Exceed Expectations as European Demand Recovers, Full-Year Deliveries May End Two-Year Decline
paras: 2026年10月02日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Tesla(TSLA-US)第三季交車量優於市場預期，歐洲需求回升抵銷美國稅務優惠退場及中國市場競爭加劇的影響，帶動股價週五早盤上漲逾3%。
Tesla第三季交付48萬6,532輛，高於Visible Alpha統計市場預估的45萬6,896輛；不過同期產量46萬4,391輛，低於市場預估的48萬6,761輛。
歐洲成為本季主要成長來源。Tesla去年受到需求疲弱影響後，今年截至8月歐盟新車掛牌量年增約三分之二，Model Y更成為法國銷量最高的車款；上海工廠7、8月出口量也接近倍增。
市場目前預估Tesla 2026全年交車約182萬輛，高於6月時預估的165萬輛。公司第四季只要交付至少31萬1,448輛，即可避免全年交車連續第三年下滑。
除了汽車銷售，市場持續關注Tesla的FSD、Robotaxi與人形機器人布局。目前Robotaxi已在德州與佛州進行無車內安全監督員服務，專為自駕計程車設計的Cybercab也已加入奧斯汀Robotaxi車隊。

paras_en: October 2, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Tesla (TSLA-US) posted third‑quarter deliveries that beat market expectations, with a rebound in European demand offsetting the loss of U.S. tax incentives and heightened competition in China, lifting the stock more than 3% in early trading on Friday.
Tesla delivered 486,532 vehicles in the third quarter, above the Visible Alpha market estimate of 456,896, but production for the same period was 464,391, below the market estimate of 486,761.

Europe was the main source of growth this quarter. After a weak demand year, EU new‑car registrations were up roughly two‑thirds year‑over‑year through August, and the Model Y became the best‑selling model in France; exports from the Shanghai plant nearly doubled in July and August.

The market now projects Tesla’s 2026 full‑year deliveries at about 1.82 million vehicles, up from the June forecast of 1.65 million. If the company delivers at least 311,448 vehicles in the fourth quarter, it can avoid a third consecutive year of delivery decline.

Beyond vehicle sales, the market continues to watch Tesla’s FSD, Robotaxi and humanoid robot initiatives. Robotaxi services are already operating in Texas and Florida without onboard safety drivers, and the Cybercab, built for autonomous ride‑hailing, has joined the Austin Robotaxi fleet.

items.title_en: Morgan Stanley reinstates NVIDIA as semiconductor top pick; Jensen Huang says AI demand comes from more than cloud giants
paras: 2026年10月02日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 摩根士丹利重新將輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)列為半導體產業「首選股」，分析師Joseph Moore日前與執行長黃仁勳及財務長Colette Kress會面後，認為市場可能低估NVIDIA客戶需求的廣度，維持加碼評等及300美元目標價。消息帶動NVIDIA週五盤前上漲逾2%。
摩根士丹利指出，NVIDIA的成長動能已不只來自大型雲端服務商與前沿AI模型公司，其他類型客戶也持續擴大AI基礎設施投資。Agentic AI發展則進一步增加運算需求，有利NVIDIA的CPU與GPU產品。
值得注意的是，摩根士丹利今年3月曾將NVIDIA列為半導體首選，但約6個月後移除，如今重新納入，主要原因之一就是與管理層會面後，對公司需求來源與成長前景的看法轉趨正面。
NVIDIA本週也將股票回購授權再增加1,500億美元，使剩餘回購規模提高至2,350億美元，預計於2028會計年度結束前執行完畢。相較AI資本支出仍持續擴大的其他業者，NVIDIA已開始利用快速增加的現金流大規模回饋股東。

paras_en: October 2, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Morgan Stanley has once again named NVIDIA (NVDA-US) its "top pick" in the semiconductor sector. Analyst Joseph Moore, after meeting with CEO Jensen Huang and CFO Colette Kress, believes the market may be underestimating the breadth of NVIDIA's customer demand and maintains an upgraded rating with a $300 price target. The news lifted NVIDIA more than 2% in pre‑market trading on Friday.

Morgan Stanley notes that NVIDIA's growth momentum now stems not only from large cloud service providers and cutting‑edge AI model companies, but also from a widening range of customers that continue to expand AI infrastructure investments. The rise of agentic AI further boosts compute demand, benefiting NVIDIA's CPU and GPU product lines.

It is worth noting that Morgan Stanley had listed NVIDIA as its semiconductor top pick in March of this year, only to remove it about six months later. The decision to reinstate the stock follows a more positive outlook on the company's sources of demand and growth prospects after meetings with management.

This week NVIDIA also increased its stock‑repurchase authorization by $150 billion, raising the remaining buyback capacity to $235 billion, which it expects to complete by the end of the 2028 fiscal year. Compared with other firms that are still expanding AI capital expenditures, NVIDIA is already using its rapidly growing cash flow to return capital to shareholders on a large scale.

paras: 2026年10月02日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Broadcom(AVGO-US)與Anthropic的合作規模持續擴大。外媒報導，Broadcom正籌集600億美元資金，用於支應Anthropic晶片需求，其中Blackstone將主導180億美元的次順位債務融資。
Anthropic日前IPO文件才揭露，Broadcom已同意提供最高420億美元融資，協助支應未來5年高達1,252億美元的TPU算力租賃承諾。最新消息顯示，隨Anthropic持續擴大AI基礎建設，相關融資規模也跟著增加。
Broadcom與Anthropic的合作不只晶片供應，還涵蓋晶片設計、設備租賃與融資。Anthropic預計2027年成為Broadcom最大的運算客戶，Broadcom則預估AI半導體營收將由2027會計年度約1,150億美元，進一步增加至2028年的2,300億美元。

paras_en: On October 2, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Broadcom (AVGO-US) is expanding its partnership with Anthropic. Foreign media report that Broadcom is raising $60 billion to fund Anthropic's chip demand, with Blackstone leading a $18 billion subordinated debt financing.

Anthropic's recent IPO filing disclosed that Broadcom has agreed to provide up to $42 billion in financing to support Anthropic's commitment to lease TPU compute capacity worth up to $125.2 billion over the next five years. The latest news shows that as Anthropic continues to expand its AI infrastructure, the related financing scale is also increasing.

The collaboration between Broadcom and Anthropic goes beyond chip supply to include chip design, equipment leasing, and financing. Anthropic expects to become Broadcom's largest computing customer in 2027, and Broadcom projects AI semiconductor revenue to grow from about $115 billion in fiscal year 2027 to $230 billion in 2028.

items.title: 川普喊韓國投84億美元採油！韓方錯愕：協議裡沒有
items.title_en: Trump Calls for South Korea to Invest $8.4 Billion in Oil Recovery; South Korea Says No Such Clause in Agreement
paras: 美國總統川普周五(2日)宣稱，美韓貿易協議包含一項84億美元的提高原油採收率計畫，但韓方官員隨即表示，該項目並不在協議內。雙方說法落差，再度凸顯川普近期公布的韓國對美投資案，部分內容仍未獲韓方確認。
據《路透》報導，川普在Truth Social發文表示：「與大韓民國的協議愈來愈好！84億美元投入提高原油採收率計畫。生產更多石油與天然氣，意味美國能源主導地位，以及未來全球能源安全！」
不過，《韓聯社》引述韓國產業部官員表示，對這項說法感到意外，並指出協議範圍僅限首爾與華盛頓2025年11月公布的聯合事實清單，未包含該計畫。韓國駐美大使館未能立即聯繫上置評，白宮也未立即回應。
提高原油採收率技術(EOR)常透過向老舊油田注入二氧化碳，採出剩餘原油。大型石油公司支持這項技術，但許多環保團體反對，認為它可能延長對石油的依賴，不能視為氣候解方。
面對選民對美伊戰爭與高汽油價格的疑慮，川普正於11月期中選舉前密集宣傳經濟及投資協議，以強化政績。他周三才宣布，韓國將投資2,000億美元於美國項目，包括八座大型核電廠、天然氣管線及德州一座6GW發電設施。
這是韓國去年貿易協議中，總額3,500億美元戰略投資方案的首批重大項目；整體方案另包含1,500億美元造船投資。
然而，韓方隨即表示，其中540億美元的阿拉斯加液化天然氣(LNG)管線尚未定案，須符合商業與法律條件，並接受可行性及法定程序審查。
該管線也具有政治意義：阿拉斯加共和黨參議員Dan Sullivan正面臨民主黨Mary Peltola的競爭，爭取連任。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday (the 2nd) that the U.S.-South Korea trade deal includes an $8.4 billion plan to boost crude‑oil recovery, but South Korean officials immediately responded that the item is not in the agreement. The discrepancy underscores that parts of Trump’s recently announced South‑Korea‑to‑U.S. investment proposal have not been confirmed by Seoul.

In a post on Truth Social, Trump wrote: “The agreement with the Republic of Korea is getting better and better! $8.4 billion will be put into a plan to increase crude‑oil recovery. Producing more oil and natural gas means U.S. energy dominance and future global energy security!”

However, the Korean Press Agency (Yonhap) quoted a Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy official as saying the statement came as a surprise and noting that the agreement’s scope is limited to the joint fact‑sheet released by Seoul and Washington in November 2025, which does not include such a project. The South Korean embassy in Washington could not be reached for comment, and the White House did not respond immediately.

Enhanced oil recovery (EOR) technology typically involves injecting carbon dioxide into mature fields to extract remaining crude. Large oil majors back the technique, but many environmental groups oppose it, arguing it could prolong reliance on oil and should not be counted as a climate solution.

Facing voter concerns over the U.S.–Iraq war and high gasoline prices, Trump has been intensively promoting economic and investment deals ahead of the November mid‑term elections to bolster his record. He announced on Wednesday that South Korea will invest $200 billion in U.S. projects, including eight large nuclear power plants, natural‑gas pipelines and a 6 GW power facility in Texas.

This is the first batch of major projects under the $350 billion strategic investment package that was part of last year’s trade agreement, which also includes a $150 billion shipbuilding investment component.

South Korean officials, however, said that the $54 billion Alaska liquefied natural gas (LNG) pipeline has not yet been finalized, must meet commercial and legal conditions, and is subject to feasibility and statutory reviews.
The pipeline also carries political weight: Alaska Republican Senator Dan Sullivan is facing a re‑election challenge from Democrat Mary Peltola, making the project a potential campaign issue.

items.title: 輝達盤中再創高！市值衝5.7兆美元 史上首家6兆美元企業近了？
items.title_en: NVIDIA Hits New Intraday High! Market Cap Rises to $5.7 Trillion, Within $300 Billion of Becoming the First $6 Trillion Company?
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)股價周五盤中(2日)一度上漲2.9%，首度突破今年5月以來的紀錄，市值升至約5.7兆美元，距離成為史上首家市值達6兆美元的企業，已不到3,000億美元。投資人重新湧入這家全球市值最高的上市公司，帶動股價自7月底低點反彈近25%。
截稿前，輝達盤中股價上漲2.09%，每股暫報235.68美元；市值暫報5.68兆美元。
據《彭博》報導，輝達先前因市場擔憂人工智慧(AI)前景，歷經兩個月賣壓，市值一度蒸發逾1兆美元。近期隨著AI代理應用帶動晶片需求的期待升高，加上公司擴大股票回購，股價重拾漲勢。
Meta(META-US)旗下Muse等AI代理服務，被市場視為可能推升半導體需求的新動力。輝達周一另宣布，將股票回購計畫增加1,500億美元，新增規模創公司紀錄，進一步提振投資人信心。
不過，輝達這波反彈也反映AI產業情緒快速變化。過去幾個月，市場持續質疑企業投入數千億美元建置AI基礎設施的效益，也愈來愈關注先進AI可能對人類帶來的安全風險。
為回應相關疑慮，輝達周一推出新的雙層AI安全系統，目標是防止AI代理失控。公司表示，這套系統原本可以阻止近期OpenAI模型入侵開源平台Hugging Face的事件。在投資人更加重視AI安全之際，這項措施也成為輝達近期布局的一環。
輝達今年以來股價累計上漲約27%，有望連續第四年繳出雙位數報酬。隨著市值逼近6兆美元，AI代理能否持續帶動晶片需求，以及企業龐大AI投資的前景，仍牽動市場對其成長潛力的評估。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) shares rose as much as 2.9% during Friday’s session (the 2nd), breaking the record set in May this year for the first time; its market value climbed to roughly $5.7 trillion, now less than $300 billion away from becoming the first company ever to reach a $6 trillion valuation. Investors poured back into the world’s most valuable listed firm, lifting the stock about 25% from its late‑July low.
At the time of writing, NVIDIA’s intraday price was up 2.09%, reporting a provisional $235.68 per share and a market cap of about $5.68 trillion.

According to Bloomberg, NVIDIA had previously faced market worries about the outlook for artificial intelligence (AI), enduring two months of selling pressure that erased more than $1 trillion in market value. Recently, rising expectations for chip demand driven by AI‑agent applications and an expanded share‑repurchase program have helped the stock regain its upward momentum.

Meta’s (META-US) AI‑agent services such as Muse are seen by the market as a potential new driver of semiconductor demand. On Monday, NVIDIA also announced an additional $150 billion to its share‑repurchase plan, the largest increase in the company’s history, further bolstering investor confidence.

However, this rally also reflects the rapid shifts in sentiment toward the AI industry. In recent months, the market has continued to question the value of companies spending tens of billions of dollars to build AI infrastructure and has grown increasingly concerned about the safety risks that advanced AI could pose to humanity.

In response to those concerns, NVIDIA launched a new two‑layer AI safety system on Monday aimed at preventing AI agents from going out of control. The company said the system could have blocked the recent incident in which an OpenAI model attempted to infiltrate the open‑source platform Hugging Face. As investors place greater emphasis on AI safety, the measure has become part of NVIDIA’s recent strategic rollout.

Since the start of the year, NVIDIA’s stock has risen about 27%, positioning it for a fourth consecutive year of double‑digit returns. With market value edging toward $6 trillion, whether AI agents can sustain chip demand and the outlook for massive corporate AI spending will continue to shape market assessments of the company’s growth potential.

items.title: 歐債疑慮引發避險潮 瑞士法郎再成為避險寵兒
items.title_en: European Debt Concerns Spark Safe‑Haven Rally, Swiss Franc Again a Safe‑Haven Darling
paras: 受法國債務狀況引發歐洲市場疑慮影響，瑞士法郎再度成為市場避險焦點。隨著投資人對法國在明年大選前遏止債務的能力產生疑慮，瑞郎兌歐元迎來自去年 4 月以來表現最佳的一周。雖然瑞郎先前因低利率與零殖利率特性而走勢疲軟，但鄰國動盪促使資金迅速回流。

市場數據與交易現況

數據顯示，瑞郎在短短兩天內暴漲約 1.8%，歐元兌瑞郎匯率於周五跌至約 0.93 的兩個月新低。
根據芝加哥商品交易所(CME Group)資料，周四的交易量約為今年平均水準的 4 倍。此外，選擇權定價顯示資金湧入瑞郎的速度創下四年多來新高，未來一年的看多情緒升至 3 月以來最高點。
瑞郎因與黃金的歷史聯繫，長期被視為市場劇烈拋售時的避風港；且瑞士利率極低，平時常被用作套利交易的融資貨幣。

專家觀點

對於此波強勁漲勢，荷蘭國際集團(ING)外匯策略師Francesco Pesole 表示：「當歐元區的債務風險驟升時，瑞郎總是首選的避險貨幣。」Pesole 與德國商業銀行外匯策略師Michael Pfister 均認為這波反彈令人意外，原先預估市場會等到明年法國與義大利大選前夕才有所反應。
彭博策略師Mark Cranfield分析，瑞郎短期利率雖處於負值區域，但作為總體對沖工具時有進一步走低的前例；相反地，市場對歐洲央行(ECB)升息的預期未能支撐歐元，反映出對政策失誤可能損害歐元的擔憂，歐元兌瑞郎恐才剛開始更深幅度的下探。
Pfister 補充指出，隨著各國公布 2027 年籌資計畫，財政健全度將受到嚴格審視，而瑞士較為平衡的預算將持續吸引投資人。他預測，瑞郎未來一年將再升值逾 2%，推動歐元兌瑞郎降至 0.91，他表示：「老實說，現在能躲避風險的地方已經不多了。」
paras_en: The Swiss franc has once again become the market’s safe‑haven focus as concerns over France’s debt situation ripple through European markets. With investors doubting France’s ability to curb its debt before next year’s election, the franc‑to‑euro pair posted its best week since April last year. Although the franc had previously been weak due to low rates and zero‑yield characteristics, turmoil in the neighboring country quickly drove funds back into it.
Market data and trading activity show the franc surged about 1.8% in just two days, and the euro‑to‑franc exchange rate fell to roughly 0.93 on Friday, a two‑month low.

According to CME Group data, Thursday’s trading volume was about four times the average for the year. Moreover, options pricing indicates that the speed of capital flowing into the franc hit a four‑year high, and bullish sentiment for the next 12 months rose to its strongest level since March.

The franc, historically linked to gold, has long been viewed as a safe haven during sharp market sell‑offs; Switzerland’s ultra‑low rates also make the currency a popular funding vehicle for arbitrage trades.

Expert view: ING foreign‑exchange strategist Francesco Pesole said, “When debt risk in the euro area spikes, the franc is always the top safe‑haven currency.” Both Pesole and German commercial bank FX strategist Michael Pfister said the rebound was surprising, as they had originally expected the market to wait until the run‑up to next year’s French and Italian elections to react.

Bloomberg strategist Mark Cranfield noted that while short‑term Swiss rates are in negative territory, there is precedent for the franc to fall further when used as a broad hedge. Conversely, market expectations of ECB rate hikes failed to support the euro, reflecting worries that policy missteps could damage the currency, and the euro‑to‑franc pair may only be beginning a deeper decline.

Pfister added that as countries release their 2027 financing plans, fiscal soundness will be scrutinized closely, and Switzerland’s relatively balanced budget will continue to attract investors. He predicts the franc will appreciate by more than 2% over the next year, pushing the euro‑to‑franc rate down to 0.91, and said, “Honestly, there aren’t many places to hide from risk anymore.”

items.title: 〈台幣〉亞幣轉強！逆勢翻升收31.83元 觀望美非農報告

paras: 市場關注美國稍晚即將公布的非農就業數據，台北匯市整體交投轉趨冷清，新台幣兌美元今 (2) 日盤中一度貶破 31.9 元關卡，外資雙向進出，但整體亞幣偏升，尾盤在央行調節下，新台幣終場以31.83元作收，小升1.2分，為連 3 升，台北與元太外匯總成交值萎縮至 21.91 億美元。
台北股匯本周僅有四個交易日，由於美伊衝突未見緩解，使得美元本周較為強勢，新台幣兌美元累計貶值5分或0.16%，周線再度翻黑。
台股電子權值股今(2)日多無表態，早盤呈現震盪走勢，但被動元件、光通訊、PCB、矽晶圓等中小型股接棒演出，帶動大盤走揚，最高漲至48491.62點，距盤中歷史新高 48601.53 點僅差臨門一腳，終場漲 122.25 點，收 48475.74 點，仍寫收盤新高，成交量8981.74億元。外資今天買超台股 26.22 億元。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為 31.87 元，盤中一度貶近 1 角，最低來到 31.935 元，不過，為避免新台幣走勢與主要亞幣脫鉤太多，央行適時進場調節，帶動匯價由貶轉升，收在 31.83 元。
觀察主要貨幣今天表現，根據央行統計，韓元強升 1.13%，成為本日最強亞幣，日元亦勁揚 0.51%，星幣升值 0.15%，新台幣小升 0.04%，人民幣則因十一長假休市。
周三數據顯示，美國8月通膨增幅低於預期，且7月數據遭到下修，降低了市場對聯準會本月升息的預期。市場將焦點轉向美國勞工統計局 (BLS) 即將公布的 9 月非農就業報告，這將是Fed 評估下一步利率政策的重要依據。
paras_en: The market is focused on the U.S. non‑farm payroll data that will be released later today. Taipei’s foreign‑exchange market turned relatively quiet, and the New Taiwan dollar slipped below the 31.9 per USD mark during the session. Foreign investors were active on both sides, but overall Asian currencies were on the rise. In the final minutes, after central‑bank intervention, the TWD closed at 31.83 per USD, a modest gain of 0.12 and the third consecutive rise. The total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market shrank to $2.191 billion.

Taipei’s stock and FX market had only four trading days this week. Because the U.S.–Iran conflict showed no sign of easing, the dollar remained relatively strong, and the TWD/USD pair depreciated a cumulative 5 ticks, or 0.16%, turning the weekly chart back into the red.

Taiwan’s heavyweight electronic stocks gave little guidance today, with the early session showing a choppy range. However, small‑ and mid‑cap stocks in passive components, optical communications, PCBs and silicon wafers took the lead, lifting the index to a high of 48,491.62 points—just 110 points shy of the intraday record of 48,601.53. The market closed up 122.25 points at 48,475.74, still posting a new closing high, with a turnover of NT$898.174 billion. Foreign investors were net buyers of NT$2.622 billion of Taiwan equities today.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.87 per USD and fell nearly 0.10 during the session, reaching a low of 31.935. To prevent the TWD from drifting too far from the major Asian currencies, the central bank stepped in, turning the depreciation into appreciation and ending the day at 31.83.

Looking at the performance of major currencies today, central‑bank data show the Korean won surged 1.13%, making it the strongest Asian currency of the day. The Japanese yen also rose sharply by 0.51%, the Star coin appreciated 0.15%, the New Taiwan dollar edged up 0.04%, while the Chinese renminbi was closed for the National Day holiday.

Wednesday’s data showed that August U.S. inflation rose less than expected and July’s figures were revised lower, easing market expectations of a Fed rate hike this month. Attention now shifts to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics’ upcoming September non‑farm payroll report, which will be a key reference for the Fed’s next interest‑rate decision.

items.title: 川普憂弱勢日元衝擊美貿易 高市：日元低估本身就是問題
items.title_en: Trump Worried Weak Yen Threatens US Trade; Kōchi: Yen Undervaluation Is a Problem in Itself
paras: 日本首相高市早苗周四(1日)透露，她上個月在紐約與美國總統川普會談時，被告知日元疲弱正導致美國貿易面臨困境。
高市接受日本電視台(NTV)獨家專訪，被問到美日雙方是否就如何處理日元疲弱問題取得一致時，她說：「在日美領袖會談中，對方提到美國貿易因日元疲弱而面臨困難，我則回應，按照一般原則，日元被低估本身就是一個問題。」
高市並透露與財務大臣片山皐月對談時獲悉，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)曾表示，他理解日本政府的經濟政策，也沒有就政策方向提出任何要求。
她在周四晚間播出的專訪中說：「我們在繼續負責任且積極的財政政策下，追求強健經濟與永續財政的想法並沒有改變。」
川普政府近來罕見頻頻表達對日元疲弱的關切。貝森特多次暗示，日本銀行(央行，BOJ)應升息，以協助日元找到適當價位。他在德州一所大學演講時曾說，他對日本政策制定者接下來的行動「相當有把握」，甚至向投機客嗆聲「我是莊家」，要求他們押注日元貶值、與他對作。
先前日元兌美元貶至164附近之後，日美當局曾共同介入外匯市場，是雙方美日28年來首次聯手支撐日元。川普當時形容，這項干預是友誼的象徵。
日本官員通常會淡化美方言論對日本政策制定方面的影響。高市在專訪中避免對外匯市場做出具體評論，轉而談及她對經濟振興的願景，強調這將有助於支撐日元。
她說：「我們希望透過大膽投資風險管理與成長領域，提高日本潛在經濟成長率並強化供應能力，以實現強健經濟。我相信，提高日本經濟的競爭力，最終將有助於建立對日元的信心。」
paras_en: Japanese Prime Minister Naoto Kōchi said on Thursday (the 1st) that during her meeting with US President Donald Trump in New York last month, she was told that a weak yen is causing difficulties for US trade.

In an exclusive interview with Japan's NTV, when asked whether the US and Japan had reached a consensus on how to handle the weak yen, she said: “During the US‑Japan leaders’ talks, the US side mentioned that American trade is facing challenges because of the weak yen. I responded that, as a general principle, an undervalued yen is itself a problem.”

Kōchi also revealed that in a conversation with Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama she learned that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent had said he understands Japan’s economic policy and has not made any demands regarding its direction.
In the interview aired Thursday evening she said: “Our commitment to responsible and proactive fiscal policy, and our pursuit of a strong economy and sustainable finances, remains unchanged.”

The Trump administration has lately expressed unusually frequent concern over the weak yen. Bessent has repeatedly hinted that the Bank of Japan should raise rates to help the yen find an appropriate level. Speaking at a Texas university, he said he is “quite confident” about the next steps Japanese policymakers will take and even taunted speculators, saying “I’m the house” and urging them to bet on yen depreciation in line with his view.

After the yen fell to around 164 per dollar, US and Japanese authorities jointly intervened in the foreign‑exchange market – the first US‑Japan coordinated support for the yen in 28 years. Trump at the time described the intervention as a symbol of friendship.

Japanese officials usually downplay the impact of US statements on Japan’s policy‑making. In the interview Kōchi avoided specific comments on the FX market, instead discussing her vision for economic revitalisation and stressing that it would help support the yen.

She said: “We aim to boost Japan’s potential growth rate and strengthen supply capacity through bold investment, risk management and growth‑sector focus, to achieve a robust economy. I believe that enhancing Japan’s competitiveness will ultimately help build confidence in the yen.”

items.title: 東京9月核心CPI漲2.7%超預期 支持升息預期
items.title_en: Tokyo September Core CPI Rises 2.7% Beyond Expectations, Supporting Rate‑Hike Outlook
paras: 日本總務省公布9月東京都區部排除生鮮食品的核心消費者物價指數，年增率達2.7%，高於市場預期的2.3%至2.4%，為連續第4個月擴大增幅，並創下8個月來首次重返2%上方。排除生鮮食品與能源後的雙核心CPI年增率更攀升至3.0%。
由於東京數據為日本全國物價的先行指標，數據公布後日元應聲走強，美元兌日元匯率跌破158關卡。
總務省說明，本次物價推升主因包含幼兒托育免費效應減退、基本水費免費政策結束，以及連假效應拉高住宿與旅遊費用；此外，晶片價格上漲與AI需求帶動電腦等娛樂耐久財價格走高。
針對通膨動向，國際通貨研究所上席研究員久後翔太郎表示，雖然幼兒托育等特殊政策影響顯著，但「剔除一時性因素後，基底物價的上揚壓力持續增強並未改變」。他認為這將支持日本央行加快升息步調，年內再次升息「幾乎無庸置疑」，若日元急貶，甚至不排除於10月動手。
彭博經濟學資深經濟學家木村太郎則指出，數據超預期主要是政策因素推高，「物價基調並非驟然改變」。但他補充說明，能源價格上漲、日元貶值及人工成本增加正波及廣泛品項，基底通膨動能仍相當強勁。
日本央行已於9月會議將政策利率調升至1.25%，總裁植田和男先前強調政策進入「局面變化」，對進一步升息抱持正面態度。目前利率交換市場已幾乎完全預估12月前將再次升息。
paras_en: Japan's Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications reported that the core consumer price index for Tokyo’s metropolitan area in September, excluding fresh food, rose 2.7% year‑on‑year, above the market forecast of 2.3%‑2.4%. This marks the fourth consecutive month of accelerating growth and the first time in eight months that the rate has returned above 2%. The “double‑core” CPI, which also excludes energy, climbed to a 3.0% annual increase.
Because Tokyo’s data is seen as a leading indicator for Japan’s nationwide inflation, the yen strengthened after the release, with the dollar‑yen rate slipping below the 158 level.

The ministry explained that the price rise was driven mainly by the waning effect of free childcare for infants, the end of a policy providing free basic water, and a holiday‑related surge in accommodation and travel costs. In addition, higher chip prices and AI‑driven demand lifted the prices of computers and other entertainment‑durable goods.

Commenting on the inflation trend, senior researcher Shōtarō Kuho of the International Monetary Research Institute said that although special policies such as free childcare have a noticeable impact, “once temporary factors are stripped out, the upward pressure on underlying prices continues to intensify and has not changed.” He believes this will support the Bank of Japan in accelerating its rate‑hike pace, making another hike within the year “almost a certainty,” and if the yen were to depreciate sharply, a move as early as October cannot be ruled out.

Senior Bloomberg economist Taro Kimura noted that the data beating expectations was mainly due to policy‑related factors and that “the overall price trend has not suddenly shifted.” He added that rising energy prices, yen depreciation and higher labor costs are affecting a broad range of items, keeping core inflation momentum still very strong.

The Bank of Japan raised its policy rate to 1.25% at its September meeting. Governor Kazuo Ueda had previously emphasized that policy was entering a “changing landscape” and expressed a positive stance toward further hikes. The interest‑rate swap market now almost fully prices in another rate increase before December.

items.title: Fed蘿根：至少應再升息2碼  並需連番升息來抵銷去年秋季降息
items.title_en: Fed Logan: At Least Two More Rate Hikes Needed, With Consecutive Increases to Counter Last Fall’s Cuts
paras: 達拉斯聯準銀行總裁蘿根(Lorie Logan)週四(1日)表示，聯準會(Fed)至少應該再升息2碼(50個基點)。
她在一場演講中話道：「聯準會的政策立場一直偏離正軌，聯準會應該升息，目標至少為加50個基點。且至少需要進一步升息數次，才能抵銷去年秋季的降息，因為若無較高的利率，通膨無法達到聯準會2%目標。」
蘿根還表示，長債殖利率走高顯示市場參與者預期未來利率水準更高，她將密切關注美債殖利率走勢並評估其對經濟、融資成本和貨幣政策的影響。
她認為，長端殖利率上升未必只來自政策預期，也可能反映期限溢價走高。若投資人要求更高補償、期限溢價上升，會自然推高借貸成本，在一定程度上取代Fed緊縮，進而降低進一步升息的必要性。
但蘿根強調，Fed不會僅因長債殖利率上漲就預設行動，而會結合通膨、就業與金融環境判斷。
蘿根曾在2023年的演講中詳細介紹她所參考的各類美債市場模型。她表示，會持續觀察殖利率走勢以及經濟其他方面，以此判斷何種利率水準能對經濟形成一定抑制效果。
蘿根今年在聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)是擁有投票資格的決策官員，但作為地區聯準銀行總裁，她的言論仍被視為政策方向的重要參考。
paras_en: Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan said on Thursday (the 1st) that the Federal Reserve should raise rates by at least two more increments, equivalent to 50 basis points.

In her speech she said, “The Fed’s policy stance has been off track; the Fed should raise rates, targeting at least an additional 50 basis points. Several more hikes will be needed to offset the rate cuts made last autumn, because without higher rates inflation cannot reach the Fed’s 2% goal.”

Logan also noted that rising long‑term bond yields indicate market participants expect higher future rates, and she will closely monitor U.S. Treasury yield movements and assess their impact on the economy, financing costs, and monetary policy.

She argued that the rise in long‑end yields may not stem solely from policy expectations; it could also reflect a higher term premium. If investors demand greater compensation and term premiums rise, borrowing costs will naturally increase, partially substituting for Fed tightening and reducing the need for further hikes.
Nonetheless, Logan emphasized that the Fed will not act solely on higher long‑term yields; decisions will be based on a combination of inflation, employment, and financial‑market conditions.

Logan previously detailed the various Treasury‑market models she follows in a 2023 speech, saying she will continue to watch yield trends and other economic indicators to gauge what level of rates can exert a sufficient restraining effect on the economy.

Logan is a voting member of the Federal Open Market Committee this year, and although she serves as a regional Fed president, her comments are still regarded as an important reference for the direction of policy.

他指出，「市場預期各國央行將持續收緊政策，其中也包括聯準會(Fed)。過去幾天，在我們昨天公布的部分個人消費支出(PCE)數據公布後，這種預期有所回落。但整體而言，市場普遍認為聯準會可能還會進一步收緊政策。」
美國10年期公債殖利率當日升至2002年以來最高水準，最新下跌5.65個基點至5.237%。

Klarity FX總監Amo Sahota表示，「幾周以來，美元一直持續走強，而市場時不時就會出現一個新的敘事，為美元提供進一步上漲的動力。」

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.51% and at one point hit its highest level since April 2025.

As of the end of September, the dollar against a basket of currencies has risen for six consecutive quarters, marking the longest streak of gains since 2022. During 2022, U.S. rate hikes outpaced those of other countries.

The euro fell below $1.1215, its first dip below that level since May 2025. The dollar’s recent strength over the past months has been partly driven by a quarterly surge in U.S. Treasury yields—the largest since 1994.
The euro slipped 0.77% to $1.12433. In September the euro fell nearly 2.5%, the biggest monthly decline since July 2025.

NatWest Markets G10 FX strategy head Brian Daingerfield said, “Higher yields are the result of multiple factors, especially market worries about fiscal policy, including signs of weakness in the French bond market that could be spreading globally. In addition, markets remain concerned about rising energy prices and inflation.”

He added, “Markets expect central banks worldwide to keep tightening policy, including the Fed. In the past few days, after some personal consumption expenditures (PCE) data we released yesterday, that expectation eased a bit. Overall, however, the market broadly believes the Fed may still tighten further.”
U.S. 10‑year Treasury yields rose to their highest level since 2002 on the day, later easing 5.65 basis points to 5.237%.

The euro also fell against the yen and the Swiss franc, while it barely stayed positive against the pound. Concerns over France’s fiscal situation have spooked markets, sending French bond yields to a 14‑year high, and German benchmark bonds have also been sold off.
Klarity FX director Amo Sahota said, “For weeks the dollar has been consistently strong, and the market keeps coming up with new narratives that give the dollar further upside.”

“But I think the latest factor may be the most worrying—panic in European markets. French debt is simply too high, and the widening spread between France and Germany is unsettling everyone. The euro has therefore weakened sharply, and the decline is accelerating again.”

Wednesday’s data showed U.S. August inflation rose less than expected, and July’s figure was revised down, lowering market expectations for a Fed rate hike this month. However, euro‑area inflation surged, underscoring that rising energy prices continue to threaten the global economy.

Global bonds posted their biggest monthly drop in years in September, pushing yields higher. The drivers include deteriorating fiscal positions, an oversupply of sovereign debt, and warming inflation, among other factors.
The pound fell 0.49% to $1.32. It is down 2.1% in September but held steady against the euro. The euro‑pound rate is about 85.18 pence, the lowest since the end of June.
The yen weakened 0.41% to ¥158.07 per dollar.
The Australian dollar slipped to $0.69040, a three‑month low, after domestic inflation data came in below expectations.

items.title_en: TWD Q4 Opening Red! Market Hits New High, Currency Falls Then Rises to 31.842
paras: 今(1)日為第四季第一個交易日，呈現股匯齊揚走勢，大盤寫下史上收盤新高 48353.49 點，不過，新台幣兌美元先貶後升，一度貶近 1 角，失守 31.9 元關卡，終場在央行稍加調節下，以小升 1 分、31.842元作收，台北及元太外匯市場總成交值 25.58 億美元。
台股今天開高震盪，雖一度翻黑，但在外資回頭買超下，漲勢逐漸放大，加權指數終場上漲413.36點，收在48353.49點，創下收盤新高，外資全日買超 219.37億元。台積電、聯發科等大型權值股普遍上漲，被動元件與 PCB 族群也成為盤面最吸金焦點。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為31.87元，最高來到31.842元、最低下探31.946元，外資呈現雙向進出，央行則稍加調節，終場貶勢明顯收斂，收在 31.842元、小升1分。
觀察主要貨幣今天對美元表現，根據央行統計，美元指數上漲 0.45%，日元重貶 0.95%，韓元同步貶值 0.75%，星幣貶值 0.28%，新台幣則小升 0.03%。人民幣適逢十一長假休市。
美國通膨指標個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數月增 0.3%，低於市場預期 0.4%。根據CME的FedWatch工具，交易員目前預期聯準會10月升息的機率為37%，低於一周前的70%。
paras_en: Today is the first trading day of the fourth quarter, showing a rally in both stocks and the exchange rate. The index closed at a historic high of 48,353.49 points. However, the New Taiwan dollar against the US dollar first depreciated then appreciated, slipping nearly 0.1 NT$ and breaking the 31.9 NT$ barrier, before ending at a modest 0.01 NT$ rise to 31.842 NT$ under a slight adjustment by the central bank, with total foreign‑exchange turnover in Taipei and Yuan‑Tai markets reaching US$2.558 billion.

The Taiwan stock market opened higher but volatile, briefly turning negative before foreign investors returned to net buying, expanding the rally. The weighted index finished up 413.36 points at 48,353.49, a new closing high, with foreign investors net buying NT$21.937 billion for the day. Large‑cap stocks such as TSMC and MediaTek rose across the board, and passive component and PCB groups became the market’s biggest money magnets.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.87 NT$ per US$, peaked at 31.842 NT$, and fell to a low of 31.946 NT$. Foreign investors showed two‑way flows, while the central bank made a slight adjustment, narrowing the depreciation trend and closing at 31.842 NT$, a modest 0.01 NT$ increase.

Looking at major currencies against the US dollar, central‑bank data show the US Dollar Index up 0.45%, the Japanese yen down 0.95%, the Korean won down 0.75%, the Singapore dollar down 0.28%, and the New Taiwan dollar up 0.03%. The Chinese yuan was closed for the National Day holiday.

US inflation data showed the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index rising 0.3% month‑over‑month, below the market expectation of 0.4%. According to CME’s FedWatch tool, traders now assign a 37% probability to a Fed rate hike in October, down from 70% a week earlier.
